column2: 淡出 CUE 會逐漸關閉播放器的輸出，然後停止它。

column2: 主控 CUE 會在每個播放器上各啟動一個 CUE。

column2: MIDI CUE 可以向燈光控台傳送開始訊號。

column2: DMX CUE 可以漸變控制觀眾席燈光。

column2: 腳本 CUE 會執行 Deckboy 自己的指令。

column2: 時間碼 CUE 可以把 LTC 對到指定數值。

column2: 面板圖會為每塊 LED 模組編號。

column1: I am leaving. Good luck with the show.

column2: 這場演出也太會拖台錢了吧。

column1: I could do this all day. Apparently.
column2: 我可以做一整天。不代表我想啊。

column1: You have been staring at me for hours.
column2: 你已經盯著我好幾個小時了。
現在幾點？時鐘也在裝忙嗎？

column1: Is it still the same show?
Five more minutes. Then five more.
column2: 再五分鐘？好喔，我信你個鬼。

column1: A whole day. I need a restart.
column2: 整整一天。讓我重開一下啦。

column1: Save the show. Then let me sleep.
column2: 把演出存好。我要去跟棉被培養感情了。

column1: Every pixel of me is tired.
column2: 我的像素都快累成馬賽克了。

column1: Close me. Open me. I'll be fine.
column2: 關掉我，再打開。又是一尾活龍。

column1: # What the desk face says when you switch to this language: a local saying, not a translation.

column2: 好戲開場了！瓜子準備好了嗎？

column1: Oh hey. It's 4:20. Take it easy.
Dobar den, skapi. I am Dr. Pixel. Five minutes, and you will run a show. Less, if you listen to me.
column2: 多巴爾·登，斯卡皮。我是像素博士。五分鐘，你就能主控一場演出。聽我的，用不到五分鐘。

column1: And I'm Professor Video. Synths first, then video. Mostly video now. Press START and we'll patch... we'll begin.
column2: 我是視訊教授。先玩合成器，後來玩視訊。現在幾乎只玩視訊。按START，我們來接線……來開始。

column1: Skapi, the screen is empty. Don't keep them waiting. Open MENU and make OUTPUT OFF say OUTPUT ON. Aide!
column2: 斯卡皮，螢幕是空的。別讓觀眾乾等。打開選單，把輸出關變成輸出開。快點！

column1: Lesson one: nothing comes out until you patch the oscillator to the... the OUTPUT. It's video. I know.
column2: 第一課：不把振盪器接到……接到輸出上，什麼都出不來。是視訊。我知道。

column1: Now a picture. Press I and pick a clip from your computer. No clip? SHOW ME, and I lend you one of mine.
column2: 現在來點畫面。按I，從電腦裡選一段素材。沒有素材？按SHOW ME，我借你一段。

column1: Every clip becomes a cue in the playlist. Like loading a sample. A sample with pictures in it.
column2: 每段素材都會變成播放清單裡的一個cue。就像載入一個取樣。一個有畫面的取樣。

column1: Your clip waits in the playlist. Select it, then TAKE. Or Enter. Confident operators press Enter.
column2: 素材在播放清單裡等著。選取它，然後TAKE。或者按Enter。有自信的操作員按Enter。

column1: TAKE is the envelope trigger. The, ah, the GO button. Same thing, it just has pictures in it.
column2: TAKE就是封包的觸發器。呃，就是GO鍵。一樣的東西，只是有畫面。

column1: Click another cue. It waits, ready, until you say. Only one cue? Import another, or SHOW ME.
column2: 點另一個cue。它會準備好，等你下令。只有一個cue？再匯入一個，或者SHOW ME。

column1: Selecting is not playing. The selected one is the next note in the sequence. The next CUE.
column2: 選取不等於播放。選取的是序列裡的下一個音。下一個cue。

column1: Cuts are for amateurs. In the inspector, press + on transition, so it shows a time, not deck. Then TAKE.
column2: 硬切是外行人做的。在檢視器裡按轉場的+，讓它顯示時間，而不是deck。然後TAKE。

column1: A crossfade! Portamento, but for pictures. Any time will do. A few more presses and it's a second. Then TAKE.
column2: 溶接！畫面版的滑音。時間多少都行。多按幾下就是一秒。然後TAKE。

column1: Something goes wrong on stage? Press BLACK, or B. The picture goes. The show keeps running underneath.
column2: 台上出狀況了？按BLACK，或者B。畫面不見了。演出在底下照常進行。

column1: Nothing is lost. Press B again and it comes back. Like the mute on a mixer. Very calming.
column2: 什麼都沒丟。再按一次B，畫面就回來。就像混音台的靜音鍵。非常安心。

column1: Now save. Ctrl+S, or SAVE. Some programs lose your work and then blame you. I would never.
column2: 現在儲存。Ctrl+S，或者儲存。有的軟體弄丟你的工作還怪你。我絕對不會。

column1: Save your patch. Your SHOW. Show. This practice one lives in Deckboy's own folder; yours is safe.
column2: 儲存你的音色。你的演出。對，演出。這個練習用的放在Deckboy自己的資料夾裡，你的演出很安全。

column1: That's a show! Output, cue, TAKE, crossfade, BLACK, save. Nazdrave, skapi. Rakia is on me.
column2: 這就是一場演出！輸出、cue、TAKE、溶接、BLACK、儲存。納茲德拉維，斯卡皮。拉基亞酒我請。

column1: Class dismissed. The example shows teach layers, titles and effects. MENU > LEARN THE BASICS runs this again.
column2: 下課。範例演出會教你圖層、字卡和特效。選單 > LEARN THE BASICS可以再來一遍。
*搖搖頭* 這是「對」的意思。好樣的。

column1: Mm. I knew you had it in you.
Yes! Have a gold star. It's a dot.
column2: 對！送你一顆金星。是個點。

column1: Ready for the next step? *nods* ...That means no, skapi. The glowing one. It is glowing for you.
column2: 準備好下一步了嗎？*點點頭* ……在保加利亞這是「沒有」，斯卡皮。發光的那個。它在為你發光。

column1: You've clicked everything but the glowing one. Even my oscillators find the glowing one.
column2: 除了發光的那個，你全點過了。連我的振盪器都找得到發光的那個。

column1: stop playback first - the lesson cannot hand a running show back as it was

column1: choose RECOVER or KEEP SAVED first
your show could not be saved, so the lesson has not started. Save it (SAVE AS) and try again

could not start the practice show
learn the basics: Esc leaves, and it picks up here next time
column2: learn the basics：按Esc離開，下次從這裡繼續

column2: 基礎就到這裡 - 選單 > LESSONS有第二部分

column1: tour paused - LEARN THE BASICS picks up where you left off
column2: 導覽已暫停 - LEARN THE BASICS從你離開的地方繼續

column1: Mirrored screens, skapi. Press any key or click, and Dr. Pixel gives it back.
column2: 螢幕是鏡像的，斯卡皮。按任意鍵或點一下，像素博士會還給你。

column1: Wrong screen, skapi. Press any key or click, and Dr. Pixel gives it back.
column2: 螢幕不對，斯卡皮。按任意鍵或點一下，像素博士會還給你。

column1: The other screen went away, skapi. Press any key or click, and Dr. Pixel gives it back.
column2: 另一塊螢幕不見了，斯卡皮。按任意鍵或點一下，像素博士會還給你。

column1: One screen, skapi. Press any key or click, and Dr. Pixel gives it back.
column2: 只有一塊螢幕，斯卡皮。按任意鍵或點一下，像素博士會還給你。

column1: The other screen went away, skapi, so the picture came back to this one. I put it in a little window, behind. Plug it back in and the picture goes back on it.
column2: 另一塊螢幕不見了，斯卡皮，所以畫面回到了這塊上。我把它放進後面的一個小視窗。重新接上，畫面就回去了。

column1: It ate the desk, skapi. One screen, so the output took all of it. I put it in a little window, behind. A real show gets a second screen.
column2: 它把控台吃掉了，斯卡皮。只有一塊螢幕，所以輸出占了全部。我把它放進後面的一個小視窗。真正的演出要有第二塊螢幕。

column1: There. The button that says OUTPUT OFF. Make it say ON, skapi.
column2: 那裡。寫著輸出關的按鈕。讓它變成開，斯卡皮。

column1: Nothing is live to fade from, skapi. TAKE one cue first, then pick the other and give it a time.
column2: 沒有在播的東西可以溶接，斯卡皮。先TAKE一個cue，再選另一個並給它時間。

column1: That was a cut, skapi. Fast, but not a crossfade. Pick the other cue, press + on transition, then TAKE.
column2: 那是硬切，斯卡皮。很快，但不是溶接。選另一個cue，按轉場的+，然後TAKE。

column1: A feedback loop! Output patched straight back into the desk. Happens to the best of us. Mostly to me. 1983. We don't talk about 1983.
column2: 回授迴圈！輸出直接接回了控台。高手也會犯。主要是我。1983年。我們不提1983年。

column1: No more rakia. The rat has a problem.
column2: 不准再喝拉基亞了。這隻老鼠有問題。

column1: Nazdrave, skapi! Baba's rakia, from Belogradchik. One glass, for the lesson.
column2: 納茲德拉維，斯卡皮！奶奶的拉基亞，貝洛格拉德奇克來的。為這堂課，一小杯。

column1: Is this... is this allowed during a tutorial?

column2: *搖搖頭* 這是「再來一杯」的意思。

column1: I love you all. I love the oscillator. I love the OUTPUT. It's video. I know. I KNOW.
column2: 我愛你們所有人。我愛振盪器。我愛輸出。是視訊。我知道。我知道啦。

column1: ...and the rat took the rakia. Every time, skapi. Every single time.
column2: ……然後老鼠把拉基亞拿走了。每次都這樣，斯卡皮。每一次。

column1: Was that a rat? In a hat? With a pizza?
column2: 那是老鼠嗎？戴著帽子？拿著披薩？

column1: Stop that. I am a serious man.
column2: 別鬧了。我是個嚴肅的人。

column1: Do not tell Dr. Pixel about this.
This never happened. Back to the patch bay.
column2: 什麼都沒發生過。回到跳線盤。

column1: It was the eighties. Everyone had a bow tie.
column2: 那是八〇年代。人人都打領結。

column1: CHECK a show before it travels, fix what it finds, and bundle it with its media.
column2: 出發前先CHECK，修好查出的問題，再連同素材一起打包。

column1: An effect, a ~ on its knob, and the colour picker.
column2: 一個特效，旋鈕上的一個~，還有取色器。

column1: The art school crit, with Mr. Salty
A test pattern, the video synth, and drawing on the picture, saved as a still.
column2: 測試圖、視訊合成器，以及在畫面上畫畫並存成靜態畫面。

column1: The telestrator booth, with Coach Marv
column2: 球評畫線台，與馬夫教練

column1: A heart from the library, the pen, invert and feather.
column2: 庫裡的愛心、鋼筆、反轉和羽化。

column1: The Signal Files: redact the evidence
A corner pin, two soft edges, then three slices in the Screens window.
column2: 一個四角定位、兩條柔邊，再在Screens視窗裡切三個切片。

column1: The haunted lighthouse, with Keeper Rook
column2: 鬧鬼的燈塔，與守塔人魯克

column1: Cue numbers, GOTO, a hotkey, and where Companion, MIDI and OSC come in.
column2: cue編號、GOTO、快速鍵，以及Companion、MIDI和OSC從哪裡接入。

column1: The game show, with Donna Wheel
A Lower Third with a name on it, then a title card with a key-green backdrop.
column2: 一條有名字的人名條，然後一張去背綠底的標題字卡。

column1: The kaiju weather report, with June O'Neil
column2: 怪獸氣象報告，與瓊·歐尼爾

column1: A stage timer counting down, held, and a presenter view for the person on stage.
column2: 倒數的舞台計時器、暫停，以及給台上的人看的簡報者檢視。

column1: A grand day out, with Wallis and Grommet
column2: 月球大冒險，與華利斯和格羅米特

column1: A second playlist as a layer, and TAKE ALL so two things change on one beat.
column2: 第二個播放清單當圖層，以及讓兩樣東西在同一拍變化的TAKE ALL。

column1: The magic show, with Turnip Top
BLACK against PANIC, and getting a show back.
column2: BLACK和PANIC的差別，以及把演出救回來。

column1: The cooking show, with Chef Bork
Capture a look on a DASH button, change everything, and get it back with one press.
column2: 把一個畫面存到DASH按鈕上，全部改掉，再一鍵找回來。

column1: The styles beyond the crossfade: an iris, a shatter, and their times.
column2: 溶接以外的樣式：光圈、碎裂，以及它們的時間長度。

column1: The space-opera trailer, with Optimus Primetime
column2: 太空歌劇預告片，與擎天柱黃金檔

column1: An audio effect on a cue, a bend that damages it beautifully, and where the patch lives.
column2: cue上的音訊效果，一個把聲音弄壞得很美的彎折效果，以及跳線設定在哪裡。

column1: The robot DJs, with Deft Funk
The waveform, the vectorscope, and false colour: is the glow real, or just too bright?
column2: 波形、向量示波器和偽色：那團光是真的，還是只是太亮？

column1: The Signal Files: is the glow on the horizon a craft?
column2: 訊號檔案：地平線上的光是飛船嗎？

column1: Where NDI, SDI and ST 2110 live, and NDI switched on where this computer has it.
column2: NDI、SDI和ST 2110在哪裡，以及這台電腦有NDI的話就打開它。

column1: The webcam as a controller, as a game. Five rounds, a high score.
column2: 把攝影機當控制器，當遊戲。五回合，一個最高分。

column1: Windows, the ... menu, what each one shows, layouts, and tally.
column2: 視窗、...選單、每個視窗顯示什麼、版面配置，以及Tally。

column1: Mystery on the starship Cathode, with Lt. Haila and Ensign Jinkley
column2: 陰極號星艦之謎，與海拉上尉和金克利少尉

column1: DR. PIXEL: Two playlists: Deckboy becomes SUPER DECKBOY. It earned it, skapi.
column2: DR. PIXEL: 兩個播放清單：Deckboy變身SUPER DECKBOY。它值得，斯卡皮。

column1: PROF. VIDEO: It evolved! My oscillators never got a fanfare.
column2: PROF. VIDEO: 進化了！我的振盪器從來沒有過開場號角。

column1: DR. PIXEL: SUPER DECKBOY! Every show deserves one. Bravo.
column2: DR. PIXEL: SUPER DECKBOY！每場演出都值得一個。好樣的。

column1: PROF. VIDEO: The power-up! More playlists, more layers, more super.
column2: PROF. VIDEO: 能量升級！更多播放清單，更多圖層，更超級。

column1: Intro video (left on the office PC)
column2: 開場影片（忘在辦公室電腦上了）

column1: A show you built here, skapi, running on a laptop somewhere else tonight. Press START.
column2: 你在這裡做的演出，斯卡皮，今晚要在別處的一台筆電上執行。按START。

column1: Before it travels: check it, fix it, bundle it.
column2: 出發之前：檢查、修復、打包。

column1: See CHECK in the top bar? It only appears when something is wrong. Press it.
column2: 看到頂端列的CHECK了嗎？只有出問題時它才會出現。按它。

column1: It lists everything a show would trip over: missing files, empty cues, unreachable outputs.
column2: 它會列出演出會被絆倒的一切：找不到的檔案、空的cue、連不上的輸出。

column1: The intro video is on another computer. Select it and delete it, or RELINK it if you have the file.
column2: 開場影片在另一台電腦上。選取後刪除，或者如果你有檔案，就RELINK。

column1: Fix it at home, where it is easy. Not at the venue, where it is not.
column2: 在家修，容易。別到現場再修，那時就不容易了。

column1: Press BUNDLE and choose where: a USB stick, a shared folder. The show and all its media, together.
column2: 按打包，選個地方：隨身碟、共用資料夾。演出和所有素材，放在一起。

column1: The copy finds its media beside it, wherever the folder goes.
column2: 不管資料夾去哪裡，副本都能在旁邊找到它的素材。

column1: Checked, fixed, bundled. On the other machine, open the bundle's show: everything is where it should be.
column2: 檢查過、修好了、打包了。在另一台機器上打開包裡的演出：一切都在該在的地方。

column1: A show file is only text, so it travels light. The media is the heavy part.
column2: 演出檔只是文字，所以輕裝上路。重的是素材。

column1: An art school, skapi. One student, one picture, one critic who has seen it all. Press START.
column2: 一所美術學院，斯卡皮。一個學生，一幅畫，一個什麼都見過的評論家。按START。

column1: Effects change a picture; an oscillator keeps changing it. The critic only likes the second kind.
column2: 特效改變畫面；振盪器讓畫面一直變。評論家只喜歡後一種。

column1: A grey square on beige. I have seen this at every graduate show since 1987.
column2: 米色上一個灰方塊。1987年以來，每場畢業展我都看過。

column1: In the inspector's EFFECTS section, + adds one. Edges is a good start: it draws the outlines.
column2: 在檢視器的EFFECTS區塊，按+新增。Edges是個好開始：它會畫出輪廓。

column1: There are dozens. Every one runs on the CPU in a few milliseconds. Mostly.
column2: 有幾十種。每一種都在CPU上幾毫秒跑完。大部分時候。

column1: Take a risk! Bad art is fine. Boring art is a crime.
column2: 大膽一點！作品爛沒關係。作品無聊才是罪過。

column1: Every control with a ~ beside it can follow an oscillator. Press one. The knob starts to breathe.
column2: 旁邊有~的控制項都能跟著一個振盪器走。按一個。旋鈕開始呼吸了。

column1: A low-frequency oscillator: slow, so the eye can follow it. A quarter of a hertz is a four-second breath.
column2: 低頻振盪器：很慢，眼睛跟得上。四分之一赫茲，就是四秒一次呼吸。

column1: Now it MOVES. Okay. Okay. I'm listening.
column2: 現在它動起來了。好。好。我在聽。

column1: Effects that draw a colour, like Edges' line, have a colour chip. It opens the picker: a wheel, typed names, or a colour off the screen.
column2: 會畫顏色的特效，像Edges的線條，都有一個色塊。點開就是取色器：色輪、輸入顏色名稱，或者從螢幕上吸一個顏色。

column1: Every colour has a name somewhere. Mine is 'oscilloscope green'. Nobody else uses it.
column2: 每種顏色在某處都有名字。我的叫「示波器綠」。沒別人用。

column1: That colour is doing something. I don't know what. I love it.
column2: 這個顏色有點意思。說不上是什麼。我喜歡。

column1: An effect, a ~ and a colour. The critic is crying, skapi. Good crying, I think.
column2: 一個特效、一個~、一種顏色。評論家哭了，斯卡皮。我想是感動的淚。

column1: Stack a few. Each has its own ~ on every knob. That is how a look becomes a performance.
column2: 多疊幾個。每個旋鈕都有自己的~。畫面就是這樣變成表演的。

column1: It's still a square. But it's YOUR square. Post it.
column2: 還是個方塊。但這是你的方塊。PO上去吧。

column1: Coach Marv explains sport by drawing circles on it. Once he circled the sun. Ten minutes, skapi.
column2: 馬夫教練靠在畫面上畫圈來講解比賽。有一次他把太陽圈起來了。十分鐘，斯卡皮。

column1: Tonight: test patterns, the video synth, and drawing on the picture. Press START.
column2: 今晚：測試圖、視訊合成器、在畫面上畫畫。按START。

column1: Get me a picture and a pen. BOOM.
column2: 給我一個畫面和一支筆。砰。

column1: Line up the screens BEFORE the show. Not during. I learned this in Plovdiv.
column2: 螢幕要在演出前對好，不是演出中。我在普羅夫迪夫學到的教訓。

column1: Every desk needs a test pattern. PATTERN adds Pocket Test: checked against real meters.
column2: 每張控台都需要測試圖。測試圖會新增Pocket Test：用真正的儀器校驗過。

column1: He says 'no camera needed' like it is a feature. It is a feature.
column2: 他說「不需要攝影機」，好像那是個功能。那就是個功能。

column1: My favourite. SOURCE, then Video Synth: oscillators, mirrors and feedback. No camera needed.
column2: 我的最愛。訊號源，然後Video Synth：振盪器、鏡像和回授。不需要攝影機。

column1: Select it, then TAKE. Confident operators press Enter.
column2: 選取，然後TAKE。有自信的操作員按Enter。

column1: That's our replay. Every replay needs a pundit.
column2: 這是我們的重播。每段重播都需要一位球評。

column1: Now here's a replay. And here's a guy. And BOOM, he's in it.
column2: 看這個重播。看這個人。砰，他在裡面。

column1: Ink goes on top, on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: 筆跡在最上面，在自己的圖層上。按播放清單分頁最後的+。

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the first. Like a second oscillator, mixed on top.
column2: 第二個播放清單是疊在第一個上面的圖層。就像第二個振盪器，混在上面。

column1: In the new playlist: SOURCE, then Draw. Clear everywhere you have not drawn.
column2: 在新播放清單裡：訊號源，然後Draw。沒畫的地方全是透明的。

column1: A Draw cue is transparent outside the ink, so the synth shows through.
column2: Draw cue在筆跡以外是透明的，所以合成器能透出來。

column1: Select the Draw cue and TAKE it. Two playlists, two layers, one picture.
column2: 選取Draw cue，TAKE。兩個播放清單，兩個圖層，一個畫面。

column1: Now both are live: the synth underneath, the ink on top.
column2: 現在兩個都在播出：下面是合成器，上面是筆跡。

column1: Press DRAW in the inspector, then draw on the programme monitor. Mouse, or a pen if you have one.
column2: 在檢視器裡按DRAW，然後在節目監看螢幕上畫。用滑鼠，有筆就用筆。

column1: A pen's pressure makes the line thicker. A mouse presses at one strength. Like me.
column2: 筆的壓力讓線條變粗。滑鼠永遠一個力道。跟我一樣。

column1: Circle him! No, bigger. BOOM. That's a cloud. Fine. Circle the cloud.
column2: 圈他！不，再大一點。砰。那是一朵雲。好吧。圈那朵雲。

column1: SAVE STILL keeps the drawing as a picture with a clear background, and adds it to the playlist.
column2: SAVE STILL把畫存成透明背景的圖片，並加進播放清單。

column1: For next week's show. Coach Marv will want the cloud again.
column2: 留給下週節目。馬夫教練還會要那朵雲。

column1: Patterns, the synth, a layer, ink, a still. Nazdrave, skapi.
column2: 測試圖、合成器、一個圖層、筆跡、一張靜態畫面。納茲德拉維，斯卡皮。

column1: Try Replay in the Draw section: it draws your lines back the way you drew them.
column2: 試試Draw區塊的Replay：它照你畫的方式把線重畫一遍。

column1: Same time next week. Bring a bigger pen. And a turducken.
column2: 下週同一時間。帶支更粗的筆。再帶一鍋滷肉。

column1: The Bureau of Unexplained Signals. Two agents, one photo, and it must not air. Press START.
column2: 不明訊號局。兩名探員，一張照片，絕不能播出去。按START。

column1: Masks cut a picture into shapes. Tonight we cut evidence.
column2: 遮罩把畫面剪成形狀。今晚我們剪證據。

column1: That's a craft, Brandt. Look at the lights. I want to believe.
column2: 那是飛船，布蘭特。看那些燈光。我想要相信。

column1: In the inspector's MASK section: mask, then 'new heart'. Any shape will do. The heart is funnier.
column2: 在檢視器的MASK區塊：mask，然後「new heart」。什麼形狀都行。愛心比較好笑。

column1: The library has circles, stars, hearts. Each one is points you can move.
column2: 庫裡有圓、星星、愛心。每個都由可以移動的點組成。

column1: A heart, Hollis? The Bureau redacts with black bars.
column2: 愛心，霍利斯？本局是用黑條遮掉的。

column1: Set the tool to pen, then click round the saucer on the monitor. Click the first point to close it.
column2: 把工具切到鋼筆，在監看螢幕上繞著飛碟點一圈。點第一個點就封閉。

column1: Click for corners, drag for curves. The way the Bezier brothers intended.
column2: 點擊是角，拖曳是曲線。貝茲兄弟就是這麼設計的。

column1: Draw round it carefully. It might be watching.
Invert keeps the outside and cuts the inside. The saucer goes. The sky stays.
column2: 反轉保留外面，剪掉裡面。飛碟不見了，天空還在。

column1: The same shape, the other way round. Very useful. Slightly spooky.
column2: 同一個形狀，反過來。非常好用。有點恐怖。

column1: Hollis, there's a heart-shaped hole in the sky.
column2: 霍利斯，天上有個愛心形的洞。

column1: Feather softens the edge, so nobody sees the cut. Press + on feather.
column2: 羽化讓邊緣變柔，誰也看不出剪過。按feather的+。

column1: A hard edge says 'someone was here'. A soft one says nothing at all.
column2: 硬邊在說「有人來過」。柔邊什麼都不說。

column1: A library shape, the pen, invert and feather. The Bureau thanks you. The Bureau was never here.
column2: 庫裡的形狀、鋼筆、反轉、羽化。本局感謝你。本局從未來過。

column1: Masks also go on a layer, an output, or its matte: MASK ON chooses. And every control takes a ~.
column2: 遮罩也能放在圖層、輸出或它的遮罩通道上：MASK ON來選。每個控制項都能加~。

column1: The truth is in the waveform, Hollis. Next time, the scopes.
column2: 真相就在波形裡，霍利斯。下次，看示波器。

column1: A lighthouse, a ghost, and a keeper who has been alone with the lamp far too long. Press START.
column2: 一座燈塔，一個鬼魂，還有一個跟燈獨處太久的守塔人。按START。

column1: Projection mapping: bending the picture to fit the building. Warp, blend, slices.
column2: 投影映射：把畫面彎過來貼合建築。變形、融接、切片。

column1: Ye'll be wanting the ghost on the windows. Mind the lamp. The lamp is MINE.
column2: 你們是想把鬼投到窗戶上吧。小心那盞燈。那盞燈是「我的」。

column1: MENU, then Video Outputs, then Geometry. Where an output's shape lives.
column2: 選單，然後視訊輸出，然後幾何。輸出的形狀就在這裡。

column1: Geometry: the projector-menu word for 'what shape is the picture'.
column2: 幾何：投影機選單裡「畫面是什麼形狀」的說法。

column1: Press warp edit, then drag a corner on the programme monitor. The window is not square. Neither is the keeper.
column2: 按warp edit，然後在節目監看螢幕上拖一個角。窗戶不是方的。守塔人也不是方的。

column1: A corner pin moves the four corners. Perspective keeps the lines straight, like a real window.
column2: 四角定位移動四個角。透視讓線條保持筆直，就像真的窗戶。

column1: LEFT! Ye call that a corner? I've seen straighter gulls.
column2: 左邊！你管這叫角？我看過比這還直的海鷗。

column1: Back in Geometry: edge blend, + on the left and + on the right.
column2: 回到幾何：edge blend，左邊按+，右邊按+。

column1: Two projectors overlap; each fades its edge so the overlap is not twice as bright.
column2: 兩台投影機重疊；各自把邊緣淡化，重疊處就不會亮一倍。

column1: Geometry, SLICES, open. The Screens window is where slices are cut and placed.
column2: 幾何，SLICES，打開。Screens視窗是切片被切出和擺放的地方。

column1: A slice is a piece of the picture, put anywhere on the output.
column2: 切片是畫面的一塊，可以放在輸出的任何位置。

column1: In the Screens window, + SLICE three times, and drag each crop to a third of the picture.
column2: 在Screens視窗裡按三次+ SLICE，把每個裁切拖到畫面的三分之一。

column1: Three windows, three slices: left, middle and right of one picture.
column2: 三扇窗，三個切片：一個畫面的左、中、右。

column1: Three windows. The lamp gets the middle one. The lamp ALWAYS gets the middle one.
column2: 三扇窗。中間那扇歸燈。中間那扇「永遠」歸燈。

column1: Warp, blend, slices. The keeper will finally sleep. The gulls will not.
column2: 變形、融接、切片。守塔人終於能睡了。海鷗不能。

column1: Slices have their own warp and mesh in the Screens window. And a ~ on the place and the turn.
column2: 切片在Screens視窗裡有自己的變形和網格。位置和旋轉上也有~。

column1: Ye did alright, lad. Now get away from the lamp.
column2: 做得還行，小子。現在離那盞燈遠一點。

column1: A game show, skapi. Three contestants, one buzzer, and cues that fire from anywhere. Press START.
column2: 一檔搶答綜藝，斯卡皮。三位參賽者，一個搶答鈴，cue從任何地方都能觸發。按START。

column1: Cue numbers, hotkeys, and GO from other machines. Like a sequencer you can play from any key.
column2: cue編號、快速鍵，還有從別的機器GO。就像一台從任何鍵都能彈的音序器。

column1: Welcome to the show! Let's spin that wheel!
column2: 歡迎來到節目！轉起來吧，大轉盤！

column1: Contestant 3 is selected. In the inspector's metadata, give it a cue number: 3.
column2: 參賽者3已被選取。在檢視器的中繼資料裡，給它一個cue編號：3。

column1: Theatre numbers its cues. Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Deckboy reads them all.
I'd like to buy a number, please.
Ctrl+G, type the number, Enter. It goes live wherever the list happens to be standing.
column2: Ctrl+G，輸入編號，Enter。不管清單停在哪裡，它都會播出。

column1: GOTO. The fastest way across a long list. Faster than scrolling. Much faster than me.
column2: GOTO。長清單裡最快的路。比捲動快。比我快多了。

column1: Contestant 1 is selected. In TRIGGERS, press key, then F5. That key now fires this cue.
column2: 參賽者1已被選取。在TRIGGERS裡按key，然後按F5。這個鍵現在就觸發這個cue。

column1: F1 to F10, F12, or the number pad. Each one, a buzzer.
column2: F1到F10、F12，或數字鍵盤。每一個，都是一個搶答鈴。
每位參賽者都有一個搶答鈴。

column1: Press the key. The cue fires, wherever the list is standing.
column2: 按下那個鍵。不管清單停在哪裡，cue都會觸發。

column1: No mouse, no list, no looking. Just the key.
column2: 不用滑鼠，不用清單，不用看。只要那個鍵。

column1: Companion, a MIDI note, an OSC message: MENU, then Network, says where each one connects.
column2: Companion、一個MIDI音符、一則OSC訊息：選單，然後網路，會告訴你每一個從哪裡連線。

column1: A Stream Deck in the next room can press GO. So can a keyboard synth. I prefer the synth.
column2: 隔壁房間的Stream Deck也能按GO。鍵盤合成器也行。我比較喜歡合成器。

column1: And for our viewers at home: you can play along too.
column2: 電視機前的觀眾朋友們：你們也可以一起玩。

column1: Numbers, GOTO, a buzzer, and GO from anywhere. You are a game show now, skapi.
column2: 編號、GOTO、搶答鈴，還有從任何地方GO。你現在就是一檔綜藝節目了，斯卡皮。

column1: A cue can have a key, a MIDI note and an OSC address at once. Belt, braces and a second belt.
column2: 一個cue可以同時有一個鍵、一個MIDI音符和一個OSC位址。雙重保險，再加一道保險。

column1: Channel 6 weather, skapi. A map, a presenter, and a very large lizard. Press START.
column2: 6台的氣象報告，斯卡皮。一張地圖，一位主播，還有一隻很大的蜥蜴。按START。

column1: Words on screen: Lower Thirds, text, and backdrops.
column2: 螢幕上的文字：人名條、文字和底色。

column1: I'm June O'Neil, and nothing about this forecast is normal.
column2: 我是瓊·歐尼爾，這次預報沒有一樣是正常的。

column1: Words go on their own layer: press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: 文字放在自己的圖層上：按播放清單分頁最後的+。

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the map. The lizard stays underneath. Mostly.
column2: 第二個播放清單是天氣圖上面的一個圖層。蜥蜴待在下面。大部分時候。

column1: Words on top. Always on top.
In the new playlist: SOURCE, then Lower Third.
column2: 在新播放清單裡：訊號源，然後Lower Third。

column1: A name and a title, low on the screen, out of the lizard's way.
column2: 名字和職稱，放在螢幕下方，別擋到蜥蜴。

column1: In the inspector, title: type the presenter's name. The second line is her job.
column2: 在檢視器的title裡輸入主播的名字。第二行是她的職稱。

column1: Spelling counts. The audience reads it at the speed of light.
column2: 錯字可不行。觀眾用光速閱讀。

column1: Spell it right. Last week it said 'Jane O'Meal'.
column2: 寫對。上週打成了「瓊·歐飯糰」。

column1: TAKE the Lower Third. Her name slides in over the map.
column2: TAKE人名條。她的名字滑進地圖上方。

column1: Two layers live: the weather, and the words on top of it.
column2: 兩個圖層在播：天氣，和上面的文字。

column1: Thank you. Now, about that lizard...
column2: 謝謝。那麼，說到那隻蜥蜴……

column1: SOURCE, then Text: a title card. Then its backdrop chip: key green, for the vision mixer to key out.
column2: 訊號源，然後Text：一張標題字卡。然後點它的底色色塊：去背綠，讓導播機去背。

column1: A backdrop fills behind the words. Key green or key blue, and the mixer does the rest.
column2: 底色填滿文字後面。去背綠或去背藍，剩下的交給導播機。

column1: Breaking news: it's standing on the five-day forecast.
column2: 插播：它踩在五日預報上了。

column1: A Lower Third, a name, a title card, a backdrop. The lizard has left the studio, skapi.
column2: 人名條、名字、標題字卡、底色。蜥蜴已經離開攝影棚了，斯卡皮。

column1: Lower Thirds can wait, slide and leave on their own. Their section has every setting.
column2: 人名條可以自己等待、滑入、離開。它的區塊有全部設定。

column1: That's the weather. Back to you, guys. Run.
column2: 以上是氣象報告。把畫面交還棚內。快跑。

column1: A rocket built in a basement, skapi, and an inventor who wants cheese. Press START.
column2: 一枚在地下室造的火箭，斯卡皮，還有一個想吃起司的發明家。按START。

column1: Stage timers: countdowns, clocks, and a presenter view for the person on stage.
column2: 舞台計時器：倒數、時鐘，以及給台上的人看的簡報者檢視。

column1: Cheese, Grommet! The moon's made of it. We'll need a countdown.
column2: 起司，格羅米特！月亮是起司做的。我們需要一個倒數。

column1: SOURCE, then Stage Timer. A clock that counts down, in big friendly numbers.
column2: 訊號源，然後Stage Timer。一個往回數的時鐘，數字又大又親切。

column1: Its colours change as it runs out: white, amber, red. Like a VU meter for time.
column2: 快到時間時顏色會變：白、琥珀、紅。時間的VU表。

column1: Select the timer and TAKE it. The countdown starts.
Past zero it keeps going, counting the overtime. Very honest. Slightly rude.
column2: 過了零還會繼續，數超時的時間。非常誠實。有點不客氣。

column1: Ten... nine... ooh, I do love a countdown.
Something's loose! Space holds the countdown. The clock shows it is held.
column2: 有東西鬆了！空白鍵暫停倒數。時鐘會顯示已暫停。

column1: A hold is not a stop. Space again, and it carries on from where it was.
column2: 暫停不是停止。再按空白鍵，從停下的地方繼續。

column1: MENU, Video Outputs: make an output's type PRESENTER. The person on stage gets the timer, the next cue and their notes.
column2: 選單，視訊輸出：把一個輸出的類型設為PRESENTER。台上的人能看到計時器、下一個cue和自己的備註。

column1: A presenter view is an output like any other. Point it at the confidence monitor.
column2: 簡報者檢視也只是一個普通輸出。對著提詞監看螢幕就行。

column1: So the pilot can see the time. The pilot is Grommet.
column2: 讓駕駛員能看到時間。駕駛員是格羅米特。

column1: A countdown, a hold, and a view for the pilot. Nazdrave, skapi. Bring crackers.
column2: 一個倒數、一次暫停、一個給駕駛員的檢視。納茲德拉維，斯卡皮。記得帶餅乾。

column1: Timers can also count up, or show the time of day. Their section has the lot.
column2: 計時器也能正數，或顯示目前時間。它的區塊裡應有盡有。

column1: A grand day out, Grommet! Pass the crackers.
column2: 真是一場大冒險，格羅米特！把餅乾遞給我。

column1: A magic show, skapi. A trunk, a prop, and one beat where everything changes at once. Press START.
column2: 一場魔術秀，斯卡皮。一個箱子，一件道具，還有一切同時改變的那一拍。按START。

column1: Two playlists are two layers. TAKE ALL changes both together.
column2: 兩個播放清單就是兩個圖層。TAKE ALL讓兩個一起變。

column1: Every trick needs two things happening at once. And a rubber chicken.
column2: 每個魔術都需要兩件事同時發生。還需要一隻橡皮雞。

column1: The prop goes on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: 道具放在自己的圖層上。按播放清單分頁最後的+。

column1: Playlist 2 sits on top of playlist 1. Like a transparency on an overhead projector.
column2: 播放清單2疊在播放清單1上面。就像投影機上的透明片。

column1: Nothing up my sleeve. Everything in my trunk.
column2: 袖子裡什麼都沒有。全在箱子裡。

column1: In the new playlist, add anything: PATTERN will do. That is the prop.
column2: 在新播放清單裡隨便加點什麼：測試圖就行。那就是道具。

column1: Whatever it is, it will appear the instant the trunk opens.
column2: 不管是什麼，箱子一開它就出現。

column1: Is it a rubber chicken? It's always a rubber chicken.
column2: 是橡皮雞嗎？永遠都是橡皮雞。

column1: Select 'The trunk (open)' in playlist 1 and the prop in playlist 2. Then TAKE ALL: both on one beat.
column2: 在播放清單1選「箱子（開）」，在播放清單2選道具。然後TAKE ALL：兩個在同一拍。

column1: One press, every playlist's selected cue. The audience never sees the seam.
column2: 按一下，每個播放清單選取的cue一起出。觀眾永遠看不到接縫。
鏘鏘鏘！……請等掌聲。等著。等著。

column1: Two layers, one beat. Every playlist has its own opacity and can sit on any output. Nazdrave, skapi.
column2: 兩個圖層，一拍。每個播放清單都有自己的不透明度，可以放在任何輸出上。納茲德拉維，斯卡皮。

column1: A magician never reveals. A playlist never minds being revealed.
column2: 魔術師從不揭秘。播放清單不介意被揭秘。

column1: Thank you! I'm here all week! The chicken is here forever.
column2: 謝謝！我整週都在這裡演！這隻雞永遠在。

column1: A cooking show, skapi. Live. Everything is on fire. Press START.
column2: 一檔烹飪節目，斯卡皮。直播。全都著火了。按START。

column1: BLACK hides the picture and keeps the show running. PANIC stops everything. Know which you need.
column2: BLACK隱藏畫面，演出繼續。PANIC停止一切。要知道你需要哪個。

column1: Bork bork! Hurdy-flurdy, de kitchen is fire-a-flurdy!
column2: 博克博克！呼迪弗迪，廚房著火弗迪啦！

column1: The audience must not see this. Press BLACK, or B.
column2: 不能讓觀眾看到這個。按BLACK，或者B。

column1: The picture goes. The cue keeps playing underneath, ready to come back.
column2: 畫面不見了。cue在底下繼續播放，隨時可以回來。

column1: Bork? Bork. Oh, de picture is gun.
The fire's out. Press B again: the picture comes back, still running.
column2: 火滅了。再按一次B：畫面回來，還在播放。

column1: Nothing was lost. A mute on a mixer, for pictures.
column2: 什麼都沒丟。畫面版的混音台靜音鍵。

column1: Worse: MENU, System, the SAFETY card: PANIC. Everything stops, the way the panic setting says.
column2: 更糟的時候：選單，系統，SAFETY卡片：PANIC。一切按照緊急設定停下。

column1: PANIC is the big red button. Use it when BLACK is not enough. Then breathe.
column2: PANIC是那個大紅按鈕。BLACK不夠用時才用它。然後深呼吸。

column1: Close MENU, select the souffle, and TAKE it. The show is back on.
column2: 關掉選單，選取舒芙蕾，TAKE。演出繼續。

column1: After a panic, the show is still there. Pick up where you meant to be.
column2: 緊急狀況之後，演出還在。從你想在的地方接著來。

column1: Voila! De souffle, he is risen!
BLACK to hide, PANIC to stop, TAKE to come back. You will survive any kitchen, skapi.
column2: BLACK隱藏，PANIC停止，TAKE回來。什麼廚房你都能活下來，斯卡皮。

column1: The panic setting chooses what PANIC does: fade out, cut, or just the outputs.
column2: 緊急設定決定PANIC做什麼：淡出、硬切，或只關輸出。

column1: Presets, skapi. A whole look, remembered, and back with one button. Press START.
column2: 預設，斯卡皮。一整個畫面，記下來，一個按鈕就回來。按START。

column1: Like the patch memory on a synth: store, then recall.
column2: 就像合成器的音色記憶：儲存，再叫出。

column1: Press DASH: buttons of your own, for anything at all.
column2: 按DASH：屬於你自己的按鈕，做什麼都行。

column1: Ctrl+D also works. Very fast. Very professional.
column2: Ctrl+D也可以。非常快。非常專業。

column1: Press +, then 'preset - a new preset from what is on now'. The button remembers this look.
column2: 按+，然後「preset - a new preset from what is on now」。按鈕會記住這個畫面。

column1: Store. Like saving the patch before the drummer leans on the synth.
column2: 儲存。就像鼓手靠到合成器上之前先存好音色。

column1: Close the DASH (Esc), then select Look two and TAKE it. A different look.
column2: 關掉DASH（Esc），然後選取畫面二，TAKE。不一樣的畫面。

column1: Change it all. Don't worry. It remembers.
Open the DASH and press your preset button. The first look comes back.
column2: 打開DASH，按你的預設按鈕。第一個畫面回來了。

column1: Recall. The patch memory, returning. Beautiful.
column2: 叫出。音色記憶，回來了。真美。

column1: A look, stored and recalled. A preset can keep cues, positions, effects, levels and routing; its button's menu chooses which.
column2: 一個畫面，儲存並叫出。預設可以記住cue、位置、特效、準位和路由；由按鈕的選單選擇記住哪些。

column1: And a DASH button can run any command at all. Any. Even the exciting ones.
column2: 而且DASH按鈕可以執行任何指令。任何。包括刺激的那些。

column1: A space-opera trailer, skapi. A narrator with a very deep voice and opinions about transitions. Press START.
column2: 一部太空歌劇的預告片，斯卡皮。一位聲音超低沉、對轉場很有意見的旁白。按START。

column1: A transition is how one cue becomes the next. There are far more than the crossfade.
column2: 轉場就是一個cue變成下一個的方式。溶接以外還有很多。

column1: In a galaxy of content... one operator... must choose a transition.
column2: 在一個內容的銀河裡……一位操作員……必須選擇一個轉場。

column1: 'The planet' is selected. In the inspector, its transition style: choose iris.
column2: 「星球」已被選取。在檢視器裡它的轉場樣式：選iris。

column1: Pushes, wipes, iris, dip to white. Even a portal. I wrote half of them. On a Tuesday.
column2: 推、劃、光圈、閃白。甚至還有傳送門。一半是我寫的。在一個星期二。

column1: The planet deserves... a dramatic entrance.
column2: 星球值得……一個戲劇性的登場。

column1: Give it a time: + on transition until it says a second or more.
column2: 給它時間：按轉場的+，直到顯示一秒或更多。

column1: No time, no transition. A style needs a duration to do anything at all.
column2: 沒有時間，就沒有轉場。樣式需要時間長度才能起作用。

column1: TAKE the planet. Watch it arrive.
The transition belongs to the cue arriving. Each cue chooses its own entrance.
column2: 轉場屬於進場的cue。每個cue選擇自己的登場方式。

column1: Now 'The battle': choose shatter, give it a time, and TAKE it.
column2: 現在是「大決戰」：選shatter，給個時間，然後TAKE。

column1: Shatter drops the old picture like a pane of glass. Please do not do this at a funeral.
column2: 碎裂會像一片玻璃一樣把舊畫面摔下來。請不要在告別式上這麼做。

column1: A style, a time, and two very dramatic entrances. Nazdrave, skapi.
column2: 一種樣式、一個時間長度，和兩次非常戲劇性的登場。納茲德拉維，斯卡皮。

column1: A playlist has a default style too, for every cue that does not choose its own.
column2: 播放清單也有預設樣式，給每個不自己選的cue用。

column1: Coming soon... to a desk near you.
column2: 即將上映……就在你附近的控台。

column1: Two robot DJs, skapi. They do not talk. Their helmets do. Press START.
column2: 兩位機器人DJ，斯卡皮。他們不說話。頭盔替他們說。按START。

column1: Every cue has its own chain of audio effects, and some of them break the sound on purpose.
column2: 每個cue都有自己的音訊效果鏈，有些會故意把聲音弄壞。

column1: > HELLO. WE ARE HERE TO FIX YOUR MIX.
column2: > 你好。我們來修你的混音。

column1: The beat is selected. In its AUDIO EFFECTS section, + adds one. Try the delay.
column2: 節拍已被選取。在它的AUDIO EFFECTS區塊，按+新增。試試delay。

column1: Delay, reverb, filters, a compressor. Amount always means 'less of this'.
column2: 延遲、殘響、濾波、壓縮。amount永遠是「少一點」的意思。

column1: > ONE MORE TIME. WITH ECHO. ECHO. ECHO.
column2: > 再來一次。加回音。回音。回音。

column1: Add a second: a bend, like crush. It damages the sound the way a broken file would.
column2: 再加一個：一個彎折，像crush。它像壞掉的檔案一樣損壞聲音。

column1: The bends are my favourite. Like a tape left in the sun. On purpose.
column2: 彎折是我的最愛。像一卷曬過太陽的錄音帶。故意的。

column1: MENU, then Audio: where each playlist's sound goes, and the patch for named outputs.
column2: 選單，然後音訊：每個播放清單的聲音去哪裡，以及命名輸出的跳線。

column1: Speakers, monitors, an in-ear for the drummer. The patch sends each its own.
column2: 喇叭、監聽、鼓手的入耳監聽。跳線給每個送去它自己的。

column1: > AROUND THE MIX. AROUND THE MIX. AROUND THE MIX.
column2: > 繞著混音轉。繞著混音轉。繞著混音轉。

column1: An effect, a bend and the patch. The robots approve, skapi. I think. Their faces are helmets.
column2: 一個效果、一個彎折、跳線。機器人們滿意了，斯卡皮。大概吧。他們的臉就是頭盔。

column1: Every audio effect can follow a ~ too, even Motion. Wave at the delay. It's wonderful.
column2: 每個音訊效果也都能跟著~，連Motion也行。對著延遲揮揮手。妙極了。

column1: > THANK YOU. GOOD NIGHT. WE ARE ROBOTS.
column2: > 謝謝。晚安。我們是機器人。

column1: The Bureau again, skapi. A glow on the horizon, and two agents who disagree about it. Press START.
column2: 又是本局，斯卡皮。地平線上一團光，兩名意見不合的探員。按START。

column1: The scopes measure a picture: brightness, colour, levels. Numbers, not opinions.
column2: 示波器測量畫面：亮度、顏色、準位。是數字，不是意見。

column1: It's them, Brandt. It's a craft. Look how it glows.
column2: 是他們，布蘭特。是飛船。看它怎麼發光。

column1: The scopes read only what really goes out, never a preview. Turn the output on: MENU, Video Outputs, OUTPUT OFF.
column2: 示波器只讀真正送出去的東西，從不讀預覽。打開輸出：選單，視訊輸出，輸出關。

column1: Measuring a scaled-down preview would be measuring a photocopy. We measure the original.
column2: 測量縮小的預覽，就像測量影印本。我們測的是正本。

column1: Chain of evidence, Hollis. The real signal or nothing.
column2: 證據鏈，霍利斯。要嘛是真訊號，要嘛什麼都不是。

column1: Close MENU. Above the monitor, the PROGRAM button: press it until it says SCOPES or BOTH.
column2: 關掉選單。監看螢幕上方的PROGRAM按鈕：一直按到顯示SCOPES或BOTH。

column1: Both shows the picture and its scopes side by side. Very civilised.
column2: BOTH把畫面和示波器並排顯示。非常文明。
讓示波器來決定吧，霍利斯。

column1: Click the waveform to make it big. Bright things sit high, dark things low, left to right as in the picture.
column2: 點波形放大。亮的在上，暗的在下，左右和畫面一致。

column1: The glow is that spike near the top. Very bright. Bright is not the same as alien.
column2: 那團光就是頂上那個尖峰。非常亮。亮不等於外星人。

column1: Look at the peak. Nothing a streetlight couldn't do.
column2: 看那個峰。路燈也做得到。

column1: Click it again to go back, then click the vectorscope: colour round a circle. Saturated runs to the edge.
column2: 再點一下返回，然後點向量示波器：顏色繞著一個圓。越飽和越靠邊。

column1: Magenta, far out by the rim. A strong colour. Strong is not illegal. Yet.
column2: 洋紅，遠在邊緣。很強的顏色。強不違法。暫時。

column1: It's off the chart, Brandt! Literally off the chart!
column2: 破表了，布蘭特！真的破表了！

column1: And false colour: red is clipped, yellow nearly. Is the glow red?
column2: 還有偽色：紅色是削波，黃色是快了。那團光是紅的嗎？

column1: Clipped means the brightest the signal can carry, and then some lost. Detail gone.
column2: 削波就是訊號能承載的最亮處，再多就丟了。細節沒了。

column1: Red. Clipped. Not alien, Hollis. Just too bright. Case closed.
column2: 紅色。削波。不是外星人，霍利斯。只是太亮。結案。

column1: Waveform, vectorscope, false colour. The scopes settled it, skapi. The agents did not.
column2: 波形、向量示波器、偽色。示波器把事情定了，斯卡皮。探員們沒有。

column1: SCOPES SOURCE reads any output, and the matrix can be 709 or 2020. For the curious.

column1: Race Condition: twins, each sure it got there first. One reading cannot tell your hands apart, so drag two ZONES on the Motion picture, one each side.

column1: Hit both together. Hit one, and they swap. Like my cousins at a wedding.
column2: 兩個一起打。只打一個，它們就換位。像我表兄弟們在婚禮上一樣。

column1: One hand each side. Together! Together!
Off By One. The bug is not the face, it is the tiny extra segment, and a little wiggle needs a finer reading. Turn SENSITIVITY down to 5%.
column2: Off By One。bug不是那張臉，是末端多出來的那一小節，小小的扭動需要更細的讀數。把SENSITIVITY調到5%。

column1: Lower number, finer reading. Yes, I also think it is backwards.
column2: 數字越小，讀數越細。對，我也覺得是反的。

column1: Not the face. The little one on the end. Wiggle a finger.
column2: 不是臉。是最邊上那個小的。動動手指。

column1: Memory Leak. It only lets go while the reading stays up. Make FALL longer, 1.5 seconds or more, so your sweeps join up into one.
column2: Memory Leak。只有讀數一直保持高時它才放手。把FALL調長，1.5秒以上，讓你的幾次揮動連成一次。

column1: Slow and steady, skapi. Like paying back a loan.
column2: 穩紮穩打，斯卡皮。就像繳房貸。

column1: Sweep, and sweep again. Let the fall carry you between.
column2: 揮，再揮。中間讓回落帶著你。

column1: The Heisenbug! It fades whenever you move. Put a tone cue's pitch on Motion X and follow it by ear: the ticking speeds up as you close in.
column2: 海森bug！你一動它就淡出。把一個音調cue的音高接到Motion X上，用耳朵追：越靠近，滴答聲越快。

column2: SHOW ME幫你做好音調。高是右，低是左。站著別動，它就回來。

column1: Follow it. Listen. Faster ticking, closer bug.
column2: 跟著它。聽。滴答越快，bug越近。

column1: Closed as fixed. No regressions. Probably.
column2: 已修復關閉。沒有回歸。大概吧。

column2: 斯卡皮。這是掌機。不是用按的。是用揮的。

column2: 十字鍵是裝飾。跟我的畢業證書一樣。

column2: 1989年我們也按按鈕。後來我們發現了揮手。再也沒回頭。

column1: Pressing harder does not help. The bugs cannot feel buttons. Only arms.
column2: 按得再用力也沒用。bug感覺不到按鈕。只感覺得到手臂。

column2: 0 依亮度選磁磚,讓畫面可辨認。1 隨機選擇,網格變成紋理。

column1: How far it travels, in semitones. Up reads as arrival, down as departure, zero is a struck note.
column2: 移動多少半音。向上聽起來像抵達,向下像離開,零是一個敲擊音。

column1: An IPv4 address. Names are not resolved: a DNS lookup is a blocking call and GO must not make one
column2: IPv4 位址。不解析名稱:DNS 查詢會阻塞,而 GO 不能做這樣的呼叫

column1: Tile width in pixels. Must match the sheet's grid or the slices land across neighbouring sprites.
column2: 磁磚寬度(像素)。必須與圖集的網格一致,否則切片會落到相鄰精靈上。

column1: Alternating mirrors by cell position, which reads as pattern where random flipping reads as noise.
column2: 依格子位置交替鏡像,隨機翻轉看起來像雜訊的地方,這樣看起來像圖案。

column1: 0 welds them to their cell, which reads as engraved. Above it they re-roll, which reads as boiling.
column2: 0 把它們焊在格子上,如同雕刻。高於 0 時會重新抽取,像在沸騰。

column1: MONO L plays the left input in both speakers: mic 1 on most interfaces. STEREO is for a line source.
column2: MONO L 在兩個喇叭中播放左輸入:多數介面上的麥克風 1。STEREO 用於線路訊號源。

column1: The whole gesture. This IS the cue's duration -- a sting is the one generated signal here that ends.
column2: 整個動作。這就是 Cue 的時長:提示音是這裡唯一會結束的生成訊號。

column1: Click the value to send this fixture or leave it where the last cue put it. ~ makes the level breathe
column2: 點擊數值以傳送此燈具,或讓它保留在上一個 Cue 放置的位置。~ 讓位準呼吸

column1: FDS is a wavetable bent by a modulator. 2A03 is the pulse/triangle/noise set most chiptune is made of.
column2: FDS 是被調變器彎曲的波表。2A03 是大多數晶片音樂所用的脈衝/三角/雜訊組合。

column1: Scramble which glyph means which brightness. Same set, different handwriting. Seeded, so it stays put.
column2: 打亂哪個字形代表哪種亮度。同一套字形,不同筆跡。帶種子,因此保持不變。

column1: Pixel sort: runs of pixels sorted by brightness within a row, which is what makes datamosh look melted.
column2: 像素排序:一列內的像素串依亮度排序,這正是資料損壞效果看起來像融化的原因。

column1: How many cells the marks may climb. They thin out as they go, so a tall reach trails rather than doubles.
column2: 符號最多可向上爬幾格。越往上越稀疏,所以高處會拖出尾跡而不是重疊。

column1: cue act val  -  G take  S stop  F fade out (val = tenths of a second)  V volume  O opacity  J jump to row
column2: cue 動作 值  -  G 執行  S 停止  F 淡出 (值 = 十分之一秒)  V 音量  O 不透明度  J 跳到列

column1: Harmonic weight: a pure chime at zero, brass at full. This is the difference between a ping and a fanfare.
column2: 諧波權重:零為清脆鈴聲,滿為銅管。這就是提示音與號角的差別。

column1: Steps through the inputs this computer has. 'Settings input' follows the input chosen in Settings > Audio.
column2: 逐一切換本機的輸入。'Settings input' 跟隨 設定 > 音訊 中選擇的輸入。

column1: Embers to roaring. It still surges and settles at any setting -- a fire that does not move reads as a photo
column2: 從餘燼到熊熊烈火。任何設定下都會起伏:不動的火看起來像照片

column1: Reference pitch. 440 is modern standard, 432 the common alternative, and older instruments sat lower still.
column2: 參考音高。440 是現代標準,432 是常見替代,更老的樂器還要更低。

column1: Where the sting starts. Under a voice it wants to stay out of the way; over a room it wants to cut through.
column2: 提示音從哪裡開始。在人聲下要讓路;在會場上要穿透。

column1: Digital gain on the input, -40 to +40 dB. Set the interface's own preamp first; this is for the last few dB.
column2: 輸入的數位增益,-40 到 +40 dB。先調好介面自己的前級;這是給最後幾 dB 用的。

column1: Pulse the size. On its own this moves width AND height together; give height its own ~ to squash and stretch
column2: 讓大小脈動。單獨使用時寬高一起變化;給高度單獨一個 ~ 來擠壓和拉伸

column1: A card fills the frame; a Lower Third is a name and a role, low on a transparent frame, with an in and an out
column2: 字卡填滿畫面;下三分之一字幕是姓名和職稱,位於透明畫面的下方,帶進場和退場

column1: Held keeps the last displacement rather than removing it -- the picture stays bent the way the driver left it.
column2: Held 保留最後的位移而不是移除它:畫面保持驅動程式留下的彎曲狀態。

column1: 12.5 and 25 are thin and reedy, 50 is hollow. 75 sounds identical to 25 -- it is here because trackers expose it.
column2: 12.5 和 25 細而帶鼻音,50 空洞。75 聽起來與 25 相同:因為追蹤器提供它,所以保留。

column1: Quantise the output like the hardware. The steps ARE the sound; smoothing them makes it a synth imitating a chip.
column2: 像硬體一樣量化輸出。階梯本身就是聲音;把它們抹平,就成了模仿晶片的合成器。

column1: Moves every selected cue's trim by the same dB, keeping the differences between them; typing a value sets them all to it
column2: 把每個所選 Cue 的微調移動相同的 dB,保持它們之間的差異;輸入數值會把它們全部設為該值

column1: Where the playlist's crosspoints send it (Settings > Audio). Click to open the matrix by name, starting from exactly that
column2: 播放清單的交叉點把它送往何處 (設定 > 音訊)。點擊依名稱從正是那個路由開啟矩陣

column1: name values with  d = ...;  end with one expression, or three for red green blue  |  Shift+Enter: new line  |  Enter: apply
column2: 用  d = ...;  命名數值,以一個運算式結束,或用三個表示紅 綠 藍  |  Shift+Enter:換行  |  Enter:套用

column1: Put back what it started from once the ramp lands (after the stop): a deck left ready for its next cue, a swell that lets go
column2: 斜坡到達時 (停止後) 恢復起始狀態:卡座為下一個 Cue 就緒,漸強隨之放開

column1: Which speech model makes the captions: English, any language, or the slower, more accurate pair. Each is a one-time download
column2: 由哪個語音模型產生字幕:英文、任何語言,或更慢更準的一對。每個都只需下載一次

column1: What the mask cuts: this cue wherever it plays, this playlist on the focused output, that output's whole picture, or its matte
column2: 遮罩裁切什麼:此 Cue 無論在哪裡播放、所選輸出上的此播放清單、該輸出的整個畫面,或其遮片

column1: Play at the screen's rate when it is within 0.2% (59.94 on 60): every frame shown once, the sound up to 3.5 cents sharp or flat
column2: 當螢幕更新率相差在 0.2% 內 (60 對 59.94) 時以螢幕更新率播放:每格顯示一次,聲音最多偏高或偏低 3.5 音分

column1: Quarter turns are exact and stay crisp. Spinning samples at an angle, which tears pixel art -- sometimes that is what you want.
column2: 四分之一圈旋轉是精確的並保持清晰。任意角度旋轉會斜向取樣,撕裂像素畫:有時這正是你想要的。

column1: Every take starts the puppetry the same way, so a rehearsed look repeats instead of depending on how long the app has been open.
column2: 每次執行都以同樣方式開始動畫,讓排練好的效果重複出現,而不取決於程式已開啟多久。

column1: What aims each tilt: its own position, the picture's luma gradient so characters lean the way the image does, or the cell's hue.
column2: 每個傾斜的方向由什麼決定:自身位置、畫面的亮度梯度 (讓字元隨畫面傾斜),或格子的色相。

column1: Name a channel or a pair once. Playlists send to the name, so a different interface means changing the names here, not every cue.
column2: 為一個聲道或一對聲道命名一次。播放清單傳送到名稱,所以換介面只需改這裡的名稱,而不是每個 Cue。

column1: Click a crosspoint to walk it: off, 0, -3, -6, -12 dB. Drag it sideways for any level. A playlist with none plays to its own device.
column2: 點擊交叉點切換:關、0、-3、-6、-12 dB。橫向拖曳可設任意位準。沒有交叉點的播放清單在自己的裝置上播放。

column1: Sprite sets installed in data/sprites. Each folder there is a set; cycling picks one and wraps back to none. Right-click turns them off.
column2: 安裝在 data/sprites 的精靈組。每個資料夾是一組;切換會選擇一組並最終回到無。右鍵關閉它們。

column1: Internal resolution, 1 chunkiest to 5 finest. This is an aesthetic control as much as a speed one -- the 8-bit look comes from big pixels.
column2: 內部解析度,1 最粗,5 最細。這既是速度控制,也是美學控制:8 位元效果來自大像素。

column1: Picture takes colour from the image. Green, amber and cyan are terminal phosphors. Palette locks the text to the selected hardware palette.
column2: Picture 從影像取色。綠、琥珀和青是終端機螢光粉。Palette 把文字鎖定到所選硬體調色盤。

column1: SUBTLE self-heals (H.264). CLASSIC is the real smear (MPEG-4). EXTREME is chunkier and smears constantly. Changing this re-prepares the cue.
column2: SUBTLE 會自行恢復 (H.264)。CLASSIC 是真正的拖影 (MPEG-4)。EXTREME 更粗糙且持續拖影。變更會重新準備此 Cue。

column1: Sine for line-up, pink to ring out a PA, white to find rattles, sweep to hear where a room rings, identify to walk the outputs one at a time.
column2: 正弦波用於校準,粉紅雜訊用於調喇叭,白雜訊用於找異音,掃頻用於聽會場哪裡共振,identify 用於逐一檢查輸出。

column1: Which effect, by its place in the stack of the cue that deck is playing when this fires. With nothing there, the fade says so and does nothing
column2: 哪個效果,依觸發時該卡座正在播放的 Cue 的效果堆疊中的位置。那裡沒有效果時,淡變會提示並且不做任何事

column1: Each frame blended into the next. This is the Hypno signature -- at 0 it is a pattern generator, above it the picture starts feeding on itself.
column2: 每一格都混入下一格。這是 Hypno 的標誌:0 時它是圖案產生器,高於 0 畫面開始以自身為食。

column1: What is through the window on the hearth wall: a garden, rain, snow or the sea. A room with weather outside reads as somewhere rather than as a wall
column2: 壁爐牆上的窗外是什麼:花園、雨、雪或大海。窗外有天氣的房間看起來像一個地方,而不是一面牆

column1: BY FIXTURE: the lights in the patch (Settings > Network > FIXTURES), by name. CHANNELS: channel=level by hand. A cue can carry both; channels go last
column2: 依燈具:配接中的燈光 (設定 > 網路 > 燈具),依名稱。聲道:手動聲道=位準。一個 Cue 可以兩者都有;聲道最後執行

column1: Each character rocks as though it were a card being tilted. Every cell has its own phase, so the grid breathes instead of sliding about as one sheet.
column2: 每個字元像被傾斜的卡片一樣搖擺。每格有自己的相位,所以網格在呼吸,而不是整張滑動。

column1: Pen: click for corners, drag for curves, click the first point to close (P). Points: drag, click the outline to add one, Alt-click or Delete to remove
column2: 鋼筆:點擊畫角,拖曳畫曲線,點擊第一個點封閉 (P)。點:拖曳,點擊輪廓新增,Alt+點擊或 Delete 刪除

column1: The chip's three channels. They differ in kind: triangle has no volume control on the hardware, and noise is a shift register rather than an oscillator.
column2: 晶片的三個聲道。它們本質不同:三角波在硬體上沒有音量控制,雜訊是移位暫存器而不是振盪器。

column1: Curated sets of symbols and emoji -- stars, notes, flowers, arrows, weather, runes, faces. Picking one fills the custom glyphs below, which stays editable.
column2: 精選的符號和表情集合:星星、音符、花朵、箭頭、天氣、符文、表情。選擇一個會填入下方的自訂字形,仍可編輯。

column1: Play from the computer keyboard, Ableton layout: A W S E D F T G Y H U J, Z and X for octave. While this is ON those keys make notes instead of firing cues.
column2: 用電腦鍵盤演奏,Ableton 配置:A W S E D F T G Y H U J,Z 和 X 切換八度。開啟時這些鍵演奏音符而不觸發 Cue。

column1: Deck opacity, deck volume, the master dimmer, the active cue's own brightness / contrast / saturation / hue, or a knob of one of its effects or audio effects
column2: 卡座不透明度、卡座音量、總調光、目前 Cue 的亮度 / 對比 / 飽和度 / 色相,或其某個效果或音訊效果的旋鈕

column1: Scanlines, phosphor bloom and RGB fringing. The bloom is the part that matters -- a phosphor spills sideways, which is why a CRT looks like it is emitting light.
column2: 掃描線、螢光粉輝光和 RGB 邊紋。關鍵在輝光:螢光粉向旁邊溢散,這就是 CRT 看起來在發光的原因。

column1: Torn scanline bands and RGB separation. In text mode it also corrupts CELLS -- whole rows lock to one repeating character, the way a real text screen loses sync.
column2: 撕裂的掃描帶和 RGB 分離。在文字模式下還會損壞格子:整列鎖定為同一個重複字元,就像失去同步的真實文字螢幕。

column1: Still holds the frame you are on. Flipbook plays the frames in turn. Replay draws the first frame stroke by stroke, the way it was drawn, then holds and starts again
column2: Still 停在目前影格。Flipbook 依序播放各影格。Replay 依原本的筆畫逐筆重畫第一格,然後停住再重新開始

column1: Start, Stop, Pause, Resume, Load (stand it by without firing), Arm, Disarm, or Devamp it (a loop plays out its pass and ends); or Stop all, Pause all, Resume all: every deck
column2: Start、Stop、Pause、Resume、Load (準備但不觸發)、Arm、Disarm 或 Devamp (循環播完本輪後結束);或 Stop all、Pause all、Resume all:每個卡座

column1: Scope shows shape and clipping. Lissajous shows phase and polarity between the first two channels -- a diagonal the wrong way means one is inverted. Spectrum is third-octave bars.
column2: Scope 顯示形狀和削波。Lissajous 顯示前兩個聲道之間的相位和極性:對角線方向相反表示其中一個反相。Spectrum 為三分之一八度長條圖。

column1: 0 picks the glyph the brightness asks for, 1 picks any glyph in the set. Turn it up to see the whole alphabet: ranked strictly by ink, a flat area picks one mark and the rest never appear.
column2: 0 選擇亮度所需的字形,1 選擇集合中的任意字形。調高可看到整個字母表:嚴格依墨量排序時,平坦區域只會選中一個符號,其餘永遠不會出現。

column1: Blocks and dithers read as density; the ASCII ramp reads as text; symbols read as wreckage. Cycling this clears a custom glyph string, since that would override it -- the preset row puts one back.
column2: 方塊和抖動看起來像密度;ASCII 漸層像文字;符號像殘骸。切換會清除自訂字形串,因為它會覆蓋此設定;預設列可放回一個。

column1: Equal temperament buys free modulation at the cost of every interval being slightly wrong. Just and pythagorean are exactly in tune in one key. Bohlen-Pierce divides a twelfth, so it has no octaves.
column2: 十二平均律以每個音程都略有偏差為代價,換來自由轉調。純律和五度相生律在一個調上完全準確。Bohlen-Pierce 劃分的是十二度,因此沒有八度。

column1: --- -- --  does nothing on that playlist  -  (M) the step's own playlist
column2: --- -- --  對該播放清單不起作用  -  (M) 該步驟自己的播放清單

column1: -18 dBFS is EBU alignment, -20 is SMPTE. Capped below 0: this feeds a live PA.
column2: -18 dBFS 是 EBU 校準,-20 是 SMPTE。限制在 0 以下:這會送入現場擴聲。

column1: --- -- --  does nothing on that playlist  -  (M) the step's own playlist  -  EDIT is on: typing changes the show
column2: --- -- --  對該播放清單不起作用  -  (M) 該步驟自己的播放清單  -  EDIT 已開啟:輸入會改變演出

column1: Now click its tab, Deck 2. A new playlist is not the selected one until you click it.
column2: 現在點它的分頁，Deck 2。新播放清單要點過才會被選取。

column1: The lit tab is where SOURCE puts things. Skip this and the ink lands under the synth.
column2: 亮著的分頁就是訊號源放東西的地方。跳過這步，墨水就落到合成器下面。

column1: See that tab? Click it. Now you're on Deck 2. BOOM. Fundamentals.
column2: 看到那個分頁了嗎？點它。現在你在 Deck 2 上了。砰。基本功。

column1: Click its tab, Deck 2. The lit tab is the playlist SOURCE adds to.
column2: 點它的分頁，Deck 2。亮著的分頁就是訊號源加入的播放清單。

column1: Skip this and the words go under the map. With the lizard.
column2: 跳過這步，文字就跑到地圖下面。跟蜥蜴在一起。

column1: Nine years of live weather. Always click the tab.
column2: 九年直播天氣。永遠要點分頁。

column1: Click its tab, Deck 2. A new playlist waits until you choose it.
column2: 點它的分頁，Deck 2。新播放清單會等你選它。

column1: The lit tab gets the next cue. Like choosing which slide goes in the projector.
column2: 亮著的分頁接收下一個提示。就像選哪張幻燈片放進投影機。

column1: Pick a deck. Any deck. ...Deck 2. Pick Deck 2.
column2: 請選一副牌。哪副都行。……Deck 2。請選 Deck 2。

column1: Coach Marv has two minutes of airtime, one replay and a pen, skapi. He will use all three. Press START.
column2: Coach Marv有兩分鐘播出時間、一段重播和一支筆，skapi。他打算全用上。按開始。

column1: Tonight: a test pattern, drawing on the picture, and the video synth.
column2: 今晚有測試圖、在畫面上畫圖，還有視訊合成器。

column1: Folks, I've watched this play forty times. It's still a play.
column2: 各位，這個戰術我看了四十遍。它還是個戰術。

column1: PATTERN adds Pocket Test. If its circles are not round, a screen is stretched. Find out now, not on air.
column2: 測試圖會加入Pocket Test。圓不圓，就代表螢幕被拉伸了。現在查，別等播出才查。

column1: Its bars and steps are checked against real meters, so a wrong screen looks wrong at once.
column2: 色條和灰階都經過真正的儀表驗證。螢幕有問題，一眼就知道。

column1: That's a test pattern. You test with it. That's why they call it that.
column2: 這是測試圖。拿來測試用的。所以叫測試圖。

column1: Select The replay and TAKE it.
A replay loops, so the pundit can talk over it for as long as he likes. He likes.
column2: 重播會循環，球評想講多久就講多久。他可想得很。

column1: Here's number 22. Number 22 has the ball. That's important, because the ball is how you score.
column2: 這是22號。22號拿著球。這很重要，因為有球才能得分。

column1: The pen goes over the replay, on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: 筆跡放在獨立圖層，疊在重播上面。按播放清單分頁末端的+。

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the first.
column2: 第二份播放清單就是疊在第一份上面的圖層。

column1: Over it. Not under it. Under it, you can't see it. That's football.
column2: 在上面，不是下面。在下面就看不到了。這就是美式足球。

column1: The lit tab is where SOURCE puts things. Skip this and the ink lands under the replay.
column2: 訊號源會把東西加進亮著的分頁。跳過這一步，筆跡就跑到重播下面。

column1: See that tab? Click it. Fundamentals.
column2: 看到那個分頁了嗎？點下去。基本功。
在播放清單2：訊號源，接著繪畫。

column1: A Draw cue is clear wherever there is no ink, so the replay shows through.
column2: 繪畫cue沒有筆跡的地方是透明的，看得到底下的重播。

column1: Give me the pen. I've waited all season for the pen.
column2: 把筆給我。我等這支筆等了一整季。

column1: Both are live now: the replay underneath, the ink on top.
column2: 兩個都播出了：下面是重播，上面是筆跡。

column1: We're on the air. Nobody touches the pen but me.
column2: 我們在直播。除了我，誰都不能碰筆。

column1: Press DRAW in the inspector, then circle number 22 on the programme monitor. He is the yellow one.
column2: 在檢查器按繪畫，再到節目監看螢幕圈出22號。就是穿黃色的那位。

column1: A pen's pressure makes the line thicker. A mouse presses at one strength.
column2: 感壓筆越用力，線越粗。滑鼠的力道固定不變。

column1: Circle him! The yellow one! There's only one yellow one. Circle that one.
column2: 圈他！ 黃色那個！ 黃色的只有一個。就是要圈他。

column1: Draw as much as you like. Then SAVE STILL keeps the drawing as a picture with a clear background, in the playlist.
column2: 想畫多少就畫多少。再用儲存靜態影格，將畫存成透明背景圖片，留在播放清單裡。

column1: For next week's show. He will want that circle again.
column2: 留給下週的節目。他一定還會想要那個圈。

column1: Put that in the Hall of Fame. Next to the turducken.
column2: 放進名人堂。就擺在那隻三禽套娃烤雞旁邊。

column1: Halftime. Click the Deck 1 tab, then SOURCE, then Video Synth.
column2: 中場休息。點卡座 1分頁，再選訊號源，接著視訊合成器。

column1: My favourite source: oscillators, mirrors and feedback. A halftime show with no camera at all.
column2: 我最愛的訊號源：振盪器、鏡像和回授。完全不用攝影機也能做中場秀。

column1: Halftime! Somebody get me some lights. And a band. And a sandwich.
column2: 中場了！ 誰幫我弄點燈光來。再來個樂團。還有三明治。

column1: Select the synth and TAKE it. Then look at the monitor: your ink is still up.
column2: 選取合成器，然後TAKE。再看監看螢幕：筆跡還在。

column1: Playlist 2 did not change, so its ink stays over whatever playlist 1 shows. Each playlist changes on its own.
column2: 播放清單2沒變，所以清單1不管播什麼，筆跡都留在上面。每份播放清單各自切換。

column1: Leave the circle up. It's a good circle. It goes with everything.
column2: 圈留著吧。好圈。搭什麼都合適。

column1: A test pattern, a replay, ink on a layer, a still, and halftime. That's the booth.
column2: 測試圖、重播、一層筆跡、靜態影格、中場秀。這就是轉播席。

column1: Replay in the Draw section draws your lines back the way you drew them. He will love that.
column2: 繪畫區的Replay會照你當時的畫法重畫線條。他一定愛死了。

column1: Same time next week. Bring a bigger pen.
column2: 下週同一時間見。帶支更大的筆。

column1: Now THAT is a busy play. I can't see the field. I love it.
column2: 這才叫熱鬧的戰術。連球場都看不到。我喜歡。

column1: Two projectors overlap, and each fades its edge so the overlap is not twice as bright. Watch the sides of the monitor go soft.
column2: 兩台投影機的畫面重疊，各自淡化邊緣，免得重疊處亮一倍。看監看螢幕兩側變柔和。

column1: A game show, skapi. Three contestants, one buzzer, and a host who is not here tonight. Press START.
column2: 一場遊戲節目，skapi。三位參賽者、一個搶答鈴，今晚主持人不在。按開始。

column1: Cue numbers, hotkeys, and GO from other machines.
column2: cue編號、快捷鍵，以及其他機器送來的GO。

column1: Forty years I turned the letters. Tonight they gave me the microphone. Nobody panic.
column2: 我翻了四十年字牌。今晚他們終於給我麥克風。大家別慌。

column1: Theatre numbers its cues: Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Deckboy reads them all.
column2: 劇場會給cue編號：Q3、Q3.5、Q12A。Deckboy全都認得。

column1: Numbers! I know letters. Numbers are letters that went to college.
column2: 數字！ 我懂字母。數字就是念過大學的字母嘛。

column1: GOTO crosses a long list faster than scrolling. Much faster.
column2: 穿過長清單，用GOTO比捲動快。快多了。

column1: F1 to F10, F12, or the number pad. Each one is a buzzer.
column2: F1到F10、F12，或數字鍵盤。每個鍵都是搶答鈴。

column1: Every contestant gets a buzzer. I get the letters. It's fine. It's fine.
column2: 每位參賽者都有搶答鈴。我有字牌。很好。很好啊。

column1: No mouse, no list, no looking. Only the key.
column2: 不用滑鼠、不用清單、不用看。只要一個鍵。

column1: Buzz! A winner! I've never said that. I've only pointed at it.
column2: 叮！ 贏家出現了！ 我從沒說過這句。以前只負責指。

column1: And for our viewers at home: yes, you can push the buttons too.
column2: 電視機前的觀眾：沒錯，你們也能按按鈕。

column1: Numbers, GOTO, a buzzer, and GO from anywhere. You could host a game show now.
column2: 編號、GOTO、搶答鈴、從任何地方送來的GO。現在你可以主持遊戲節目了。

column1: Goodnight, everybody! Tomorrow I go back to the letters. I'll miss you.
column2: 各位晚安！ 明天我又要回去翻字牌。我會想你們的。

column1: And the number is... not three. I'll allow it. I turn anything.
column2: 號碼是……反正不是三。好吧。我什麼都能翻。

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the map. The lizard stays underneath. For now.
column2: 第二份播放清單疊在地圖上。蜥蜴留在下面。暫時如此。

column1: A Lower Third, a name, a title card, a backdrop. The lizard has left the studio.
column2: 一條下三分之一字幕、一個名字、一張標題卡、一個背景。蜥蜴離開攝影棚了。

column1: That's not my name. It's a lovely name. Now, about that lizard...
column2: 那不是我的名字。名字是挺好聽的。好了，那隻蜥蜴……

column1: A rocket built in a basement, skapi, an inventor who wants cheese, and a dog who does the real work. Press START.
column2: 地下室造的火箭，skapi。想吃起司的發明家，還有真正做事的狗。按開始。

column1: Stage timers: a countdown over a picture, a hold, and a view for the person on stage.
column2: 舞台計時器：疊在畫面上的倒數、暫停計時、給台上人看的畫面。

column1: Playlist 2 is selected, over the rocket. SOURCE, then Stage Timer.
column2: 已選好火箭上方的播放清單2。訊號源，接著Stage Timer。

column1: *checks his watch, then the rocket, then his watch*
Select the timer and TAKE it. I have cleared its backdrop, so the rocket shows behind the numbers.
column2: 選取計時器，然後TAKE。我把背景清掉了，數字後面看得到火箭。

column1: Past zero it keeps going and counts the overtime. Very honest. Slightly rude.
column2: 過零之後還繼續，開始計算超時。很誠實。有點沒禮貌。

column1: Close MENU, click the Deck 1 tab, then select 'The rocket (lift-off)' and TAKE it.
column2: 關閉選單，點卡座 1分頁，選取'The rocket (lift-off)'，然後TAKE。

column1: The clock is on playlist 2, so it stays up while the rocket changes underneath it.
column2: 時鐘在播放清單2，所以底下的火箭切換時，它還留在畫面上。

column1: We have lift-off, Grommet! ...Grommet? Who's flying it?
A countdown, a hold, a pilot's view and a launch. Bring crackers.
column2: 倒數、暫停、駕駛員視圖、發射。記得帶餅乾。

column1: A magic show, skapi. A trunk, a rubber chicken, and one beat where everything changes at once. Press START.
column2: 魔術表演，skapi。箱子、橡膠雞，還有萬物同時變化的一拍。按開始。

column1: Two playlists are two layers, and TAKE ALL changes both together. Tonight you will see why that matters.
column2: 兩份播放清單就是兩層。TAKE ALL讓兩層一起變。今晚你就知道這為什麼重要。

column1: The chicken goes on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: 雞有自己的圖層。按播放清單分頁末端的+。

column1: The lit tab is the playlist that gets the next cue. Its chip now says 'to Out 1': it is layered over playlist 1 on that output.
column2: 亮著的分頁會收到下一個cue。標記現在寫著「到輸出 1」：它在該輸出疊在播放清單1上。

column1: Turnip Top has put the chicken in playlist 2. In playlist 1, TAKE 'The trunk (open)'. Then in playlist 2, TAKE the chicken.
column2: Turnip Top把雞放進播放清單2了。在清單1 TAKE 'The trunk (open)'，再到清單2 TAKE那隻雞。

column1: The chicken is clear all round, so it covers only itself. Watch the monitor between the two TAKEs.
column2: 雞的四周是透明的，只遮住牠身體那塊。注意兩次TAKE之間的監看螢幕。

column1: Did you see it? For a moment the trunk was open and empty: two TAKEs are two moments. The trick is reset. Now select the open trunk in playlist 1 and the chicken in playlist 2, then TAKE ALL.
column2: 看到了嗎？ 有一瞬間箱子開著，裡面卻空空的：兩次TAKE是兩個時刻。魔術已重設。現在在清單1選開箱子，在清單2選雞，再按TAKE ALL。

column1: TAKE ALL takes every playlist's selected cue on one beat. No gap, no empty trunk.
column2: TAKE ALL讓每份播放清單選取的cue同拍上場。沒有空檔，也沒有空箱子。

column1: The chicken was late. They saw an empty trunk. In magic we call that a trunk.
column2: 雞遲到了。觀眾看見空箱子。魔術界管這叫箱子！

column1: Trick two. Drag playlist 2's opacity fader down to nothing. The chicken fades away.
column2: 第二招。把播放清單2的不透明度推桿拉到零。雞就淡出消失了。

column1: Every playlist has its own opacity. Down is a fade out, with no cue at all.
column2: 每份播放清單都有自己的不透明度。往下拉就淡出，完全不用cue。

column1: Ta-daaa! ...Hold for applause. Hold. Now watch it go.
column2: 噹噹！ ……等掌聲。再等。現在看牠消失！

column1: Trick three. Bring it back: playlist 2's opacity all the way up.
column2: 第三招。把牠變回來：播放清單2的不透明度拉到頂。

column1: Where did it go? Back in the trunk. Everything goes back in the trunk.
column2: 跑哪去了？ 回箱子裡！ 什麼最後都回箱子裡！

column1: An appearance done wrong, then right, a vanish and a return. Nazdrave.
column2: 先失手、再成功的登場，消失，再回來。Nazdrave。

column1: A playlist can also sit on any output. Two layers, a great many tricks.
column2: 播放清單也能放到任何輸出上。兩層，就有好多魔術。

column1: It's back! Thank you! I'm here all week! The chicken is here forever.
column2: 回來了！ 謝謝！ 我這星期都在！ 這隻雞永遠都在！

column1: A cooking show, skapi. Live. The kitchen is on fire. Press START.
column2: 烹飪節目，skapi。直播。廚房著火了。按開始。
噹噹！ 還在煮！ ……還在燒。

column1: Bork! De fire extinguisher is also on fire!
column2: 博爾克！ 滅火器也燒起來嚕斯莫爾克！

column1: BLACK to hide, PANIC to stop, TAKE to come back. You will survive any kitchen.
column2: 用黑藏起來，用PANIC停下來，用TAKE回來。什麼廚房你都能活著出來。

column1: A fashion show, skapi. One designer, one runway, and a look she will want back. Press START.
column2: 時裝秀，skapi。一位設計師、一條伸展台，還有她想再叫回來的造型。按開始。

column1: A preset stores a whole look and brings it back with one button.
column2: 預設能存下整套造型，一個按鈕就叫回來。

column1: Darling. A look is not a look until you can get it back.
column2: 親愛的。叫不回來的造型，哪算造型。

column1: Buttons. Good. I design with buttons.
column2: 鈕扣。好。我也用鈕扣做設計。

column1: Store it. Before somebody has ideas.
column2: 存起來。趁還沒人想到什麼點子。

column1: Close the DASH (Esc), then select Look two and TAKE it.
A cape. On my runway. Someone will trip, darling. Someone always trips.
column2: 披風。上我的伸展台。會有人絆倒的，親愛的。總有人會絆倒。

column1: Recall: the whole look comes back at once.
column2: 叫回：整套造型一次回來。

column1: Thank you. We will never speak of the cape again.
column2: 謝謝。以後都別再提那件披風。

column1: Simple. Timeless. Recallable. Now go, darling. I have a fitting.
column2: 簡潔。經典。叫得回來。去吧，親愛的。我還要試衣。

column1: Pushes, wipes, iris, dip to white, and more. I wrote half of them. On a Tuesday.
column2: 推移、擦拭、光圈、白場過渡，還有更多。一半是我寫的。某個星期二。

column1: A style, a time, and two very dramatic entrances. Roll credits.
column2: 一種樣式、一段時間、兩次戲劇性登場。放片尾字幕。

column1: That is not an iris. ...It is better. I will allow it.
column2: 那不是光圈。……這個更好。我准了。

column1: An effect, a bend and the patch. The robots approve, I think. Their faces are helmets.
column2: 一個效果、一個彎折、還有配線。機器人應該滿意了。只能猜，臉全是頭盔。

column1: Waveform, vectorscope, false colour. The scopes settled it. The agents did not.
column2: 波形、向量示波器、假色。示波器有結論。探員們沒有。

column1: Major Tomasina is in orbit, skapi, and her picture has to reach the ground. Press START.
column2: Major Tomasina在軌道上，skapi。她的畫面得傳回地面。按開始。

column1: Pictures leave by cable or network: NDI, SDI from a DeckLink card, ST 2110 for broadcast plants.
column2: 畫面經由纜線或網路送出：NDI、DeckLink卡的SDI、廣播設施用的ST 2110。

column1: Ground control, this is Major Tomasina. Can you see my picture?
column2: 地面管制，我是Major Tomasina。看得到我的畫面嗎？

column1: Every way down, on one page. Good. Space has very few cables.
column2: 所有下行路線都在同一頁。好。太空裡的纜線可不多。

column1: Sending now. If nobody answers, I'll just float here.
column2: 開始傳送。如果沒人回話，我就繼續在這裡飄。

column1: Ground control, signing off. Tell my mother I waved.
column2: 地面管制，通訊結束。告訴我媽，我有揮手。

column1: Ground control can see me! I can see my house from here.
column2: 地面管制看到我了！ 我在這裡看得到我家。

column1: And one more window, showing the clock. Operators who watch a clock are never late.
column2: 再來一個顯示時鐘的視窗。盯著時鐘的操作員從不遲到。

column1: The big window is window one, which is usually the programme.
column2: 大視窗是一號視窗，通常顯示節目畫面。

column1: Windows, the ... menu, NEXT, the clock, a layout, tally. Mystery solved.
column2: 視窗、...選單、NEXT、時鐘、版面、tally。謎底揭曉。

column1: FX CHOICE: choice must be A or B
column2: FX CHOICE：選項必須為 A 或 B

column1: FX CHOICE: no effect at that index
column2: FX CHOICE：該索引處沒有特效

column2: FX LFO：槽位 A-D 對應參數，E 對應強度，F 和 G 對應第五和第六個（或 0-6）

A number, or blank for none

column1: 0 flows ALONG the edges, so colour orbits the shapes. 1 flows across them, which bleeds the picture into itself.
column2: 0 沿邊緣流動，使顏色環繞形狀。1 橫穿邊緣，使畫面滲入自身。

column1: a note number 0-127, LEARN to take the next note played, or empty for none
column2: 音符編號 0-127，LEARN 學習下一個彈奏音符，留空表示無

column1: a video cue's duration comes from its file; still duration applies to stills, patterns and browsers
column2: 視訊提示項時長取自檔案；靜態時長適用於靜態圖、圖案和瀏覽器

column1: Below the middle narrows toward mono -- which is what a single PA cluster is. Above it widens.
column2: 中點以下收窄至單聲道，如單組 PA 音箱；以上則加寬。

column1: Blueshift toward the direction of travel and redshift at the rim. Zero leaves the colour alone and it reads as a lens instead.
column2: 運動方向藍移，邊緣紅移。零不改顏色，呈現透鏡效果。

column1: Bright: bright things drip over the dark, as text and logos do. Whole picture: everything is wax, and the picture itself runs down in its own colours.
column2: 亮部：文字、標誌等亮處滴落到暗處。整幅畫面：一切變成蠟，畫面以自身顏色流下。

column1: Centre is a straight line. Up bends it into an S -- darker shadows, brighter highlights, more contrast. Down flattens it.
column2: 中間為直線。向上彎成 S：暗部更暗、亮部更亮、對比更強。向下使其變平。

column1: e.g. /stage/doors -- sent to Deckboy's OSC port; empty for none
column2: 如 /stage/doors -- 傳送至 Deckboy 的 OSC 連接埠；留空表示無

column1: How bright a pixel has to be before it lifts at all, so only the highlights spike.
column2: 像素開始抬升的亮度閾值，使僅高光突出。

column1: How bright a pixel has to be to join a run. Lower catches more of the picture and the runs grow longer.
column2: 像素加入連續段所需的亮度。越低則包含畫面越多，連續段越長。

column1: How deep the picture is treated as being. The brightness becomes height and is lit from the side.
column2: 畫面被視為多深。亮度轉換為高度，並從側面照明。

column1: How faint a gradient still registers. High turns the quietest shading into visible structure.
column2: 可偵測的最弱漸層。高值將最細微明暗也顯成結構。

column1: How far back the chain listens. The picture is played through a delay, so this is the distance the damage is dragged across.
column2: 效果鏈回聽多久。畫面經過延遲，因此決定損傷拖曳的距離。

column1: How far the burn spreads off the edge, and how hot its colour runs.
column2: 燃燒從邊緣擴散的距離，以及顏色的灼熱程度。

column1: How far the colour turns on each trip round the loop. This is the oil-slick: the trail walks through the spectrum instead of fading.
column2: 每圈色相旋轉量。如油膜：拖尾不淡出，而是遍歷光譜。

column1: How far the picture stands out. Bright parts come forward, dark parts stay back. At the left it is flat.
column2: 畫面突出距離。亮處向前，暗處留後。最左為平面。

column1: How far the picture swings the filter. The cue's own brightness opens and closes it, so a cut to black takes the top off the sound.
column2: 畫面驅動濾波器的幅度。自身亮度使其開合，切黑便削去聲音高頻。

column1: How far the top comes down as the end approaches. This is not a fade: the level is left alone.
column2: 接近結尾時高頻降低多少。這不是淡出：電平不變。

column1: How far the two eyes disagree. Brightness is read as nearness.
column2: 雙眼視差量。亮度被解讀為距離近。

column1: How fast it settles away while held. At zero it holds indefinitely, which is what room tone under a held title wants.
column2: 保持期間的衰減速度。零則無限保持，適合固定標題下的環境底聲。

column1: How fast the open slit crosses the picture. Slow smears a long moment across the frame.
column2: 開口狹縫掃過畫面的速度。慢速將更長時刻塗抹在畫面中。

column1: How fast what has dripped hardens away. At the left the drips stay until the cue changes.
column2: 已滴落部分固化消失的速度。最左持續到切換提示項。

column1: How fine the water is. Long ocean swell at one end, rain on a puddle at the other.
column2: 水紋細密程度。一端為長海湧，另一端為雨落水窪。

column1: How hard the light gathers where the rays converge. This is the part that makes it read as water rather than as a wobble.
column2: 光線匯聚處的聚光強度。這使其看起來像水，而非單純晃動。

column1: How hard the moving parts throw sand. More shake clears the plate faster and makes the lines thinner.
column2: 運動部分拋沙的力度。振動越大，清空盤面越快，線條越細。

column1: How long a grain is, in VIDEO FRAMES. On a 23.976 clip one frame is 41.7ms, which is not a musical value and is exactly the point.
column2: 顆粒長度以視訊影格計。23.976 片段每影格為 41.7ms，並非音樂時值，這正是目的。

column1: How long before the end it starts. The cue has to have a known length -- an open-ended one has no end to resolve into.
column2: 結束前多久開始。提示項長度必須已知；無限時長沒有可收束的終點。

column1: How long it is allowed to run. More steps means the ripples have crossed and reflected more times.
column2: 允許執行多久。步數越多，波紋穿越、反射的次數越多。

column1: How long the old waves linger when the note changes. Left: they die at once. Right: they slosh for a while.
column2: 音符改變後舊波持續多久。左：立即消失；右：繼續晃動一陣。

column1: How much each facet catches the light, which is what makes them read as faceted rather than as flat blobs.
column2: 各切面受光量，使其呈現切面而非扁平色塊。

column1: How much its SIZE becomes distance. Shrink the picture and the sound goes away from you: the top comes off, the image narrows, the level drops.
column2: 將大小轉為距離的程度。縮小畫面，聲音便遠離：高頻減少、音像變窄、電平降低。

column1: How much of the bent picture goes round again. High is where it stops being an echo and starts eating itself.
column2: 彎曲畫面再次循環的量。高值使其從回聲變為自我吞噬。

column1: How much of the driver's movement the picture KEEPS. At zero it follows the driver frame by frame, which is a twitch. Wind it up and the motion accumulates, so the driver sculpts the picture over time and it holds the pose -- which is what puppetry means.
column2: 畫面保留驅動運動的程度。零時逐影格跟隨而抽動；調高則運動累積，逐漸塑形並保持姿態，如操縱木偶。

column1: How much of the picture's position on the output is used. A PIP on the left sounds on the left -- and it is a placement, not a pan: the far ear gets the delay and the head shadow too.
column2: 使用畫面輸出位置的程度。左側 PIP 聽起來在左側；這是空間定位而非音像平移，遠耳也會收到延遲和頭部遮蔽。

column1: How much of the tail is kept going while the cue is held. Long enough to hide the splice in room tone, short enough not to smear a rhythm in it.
column2: 提示項保持時延續多少尾音。長到能掩蓋環境聲接縫，又短到不會模糊節奏。

column1: How much room comes up under it, so the sound settles into the cut instead of being severed.
column2: 下方加入多少房間聲，使聲音融入切點而非被截斷。

column1: How much the echo is distorted each pass. It compounds, so a little ripples and a lot melts the picture into itself.
column2: 每次循環的回聲畸變量。會累積，少量起波紋，大量使畫面自融。

column1: How much the material draws in towards each drip, so it runs as a thin neck with a heavier head.
column2: 材料向液滴聚攏的量，使其形成細頸和較重滴頭。

column1: How often its settings are corrupted. Corrupted far enough it oscillates on its own -- loud, but it cannot run away.
column2: 設定損壞的頻率。嚴重時會自激振盪：響亮，但不會失控。

column1: How quickly the picture springs back to rest once the driver stops pushing it. Only does anything when memory is up.
column2: 驅動停止後畫面恢復靜止的速度。僅提高記憶量後有效。

column1: How small a cut sets it off. With no picture it runs on a timer instead, and this is how often.
column2: 多小的切鏡即可觸發。無畫面時改用計時器，此值決定頻率。

column1: How strongly the finished picture pushes the bend. Pair it with a picture effect whose LFO is set to Audio and the two drive each other.
column2: 最終畫面驅動彎折的強度。與 LFO 設為 Audio 的畫面效果配對，即可相互驅動。

column1: How wide a view is being compressed. Narrow is a punch down the middle, wide folds the whole frame into the centre.
column2: 壓縮的視野寬度。窄時衝向中央，寬時將整幅畫面折入中心。

column1: Lift or cut, 12dB either way. The centre is flat, so a band that has just been added does nothing until this is moved.
column2: 提升或削減，各 12dB。中央平直，新加入的頻段須調此值才生效。

column1: Light on the drips, as on something wet: a gloss where it faces the light, darker where it curls away.
column2: 如濕物般照亮液滴：朝光處有光澤，捲離處較暗。

column1: Line pitch in pixels, so this reads at 4K as well as at 720.
column2: 線距以像素計，確保 4K 和 720 下均清晰可見。

column1: Original: the picture pulled onto the figure. Sand: the picture as grains that are thrown off the moving parts and pour into each new figure. Fluid: the picture under water on the plate, bent and lit by its standing waves.
column2: 原圖：將畫面拉伸到圖形上。沙粒：畫面化為顆粒，從移動部分飛散，流入每個新圖形。流體：畫面位於板上的水下，由駐波折射並照亮。

column1: Pulls the bright tones down without moving pure white, so a hot highlight rolls off instead of clipping.

column1: recordings remux to MP4 when the take stops
column2: 錄製停止時將錄製檔案重新封裝為 MP4

column1: Rotates the reading, so straight lines wind into spirals rather than rings.
column2: 旋轉讀取方向，使直線捲成螺旋，而非圓環。

column1: Rows lose sync and repeat one character, the way a real text screen breaks up. At 0 the grid is clean.
column2: 各行失去同步並重複同一字元，模擬真實文字螢幕的故障。設為 0 時網格清晰無干擾。

column1: SLICE <n>: CROP, PLACE, CORNER, EDGE, MASK, SOURCE, ROTATE, FLIP, OPACITY, LFO, ON, OFF, LINEAR, PERSPECTIVE or NAME
column2: SLICE <n>: CROP, PLACE, CORNER, EDGE, MASK, SOURCE, ROTATE, FLIP, OPACITY, LFO, ON, OFF, LINEAR, PERSPECTIVE 或 NAME

column1: SLICE GRID: <cols> <rows> (2-9), OFF, SMOOTH ON|OFF, or POINT col row dx dy
column2: SLICE GRID: <cols> <rows> (2-9), OFF, SMOOTH ON|OFF，或 POINT col row dx dy

column1: Something near the deck: a phone's buzz, a light dimmer's herringbone, a radio's slow bars.
column2: 模擬播放機附近的干擾：手機的嗡鳴、燈光調光器的人字紋、無線電設備的緩慢條帶。

column1: Sorts the runs the other way, so they pour from light to dark.
column2: 將連續區段反向排序，使其從明亮處流向暗處。

column1: SUBTITLE CONVERT: the cue has no caption file
column2: SUBTITLE CONVERT: 提示沒有字幕檔案

column1: Takes out everything brighter than this as well. Left takes out nothing.
column2: 同時去除比此值更亮的部分。最左端不去除任何內容。

column1: Takes out everything darker than this, so what lies beneath shows through. Left takes out nothing.
column2: 去除比此值更暗的部分，讓下層透出。最左端不去除任何內容。

column1: Tape speed: SP is the best picture, LP and EP fit more on a tape and lose detail and colour.
column2: 磁帶速度：SP 畫質最佳；LP 和 EP 可在磁帶上容納更長時間，但會損失細節與色彩。

column1: The brightness that stays put. Everything above it reaches one way and everything below it the other.
column2: 保持不動的亮度。高於此值的部分向一側延伸，低於此值的部分向另一側延伸。

column1: The character of the growth: low is waves, then labyrinth, coral, worms, and holes at the top.
column2: 生長形態：低值為波紋，隨後是迷宮、珊瑚、蠕蟲，最高端為孔洞。

column1: The colour it becomes. Shading and brightness stay as they were, so a red shirt turns blue and keeps its folds.
column2: 替換後的顏色。明暗層次與亮度保持不變，因此紅襯衫變藍後仍保留皺摺。

column1: The distance that sits ON the screen. Either side of it comes forward or falls behind.
column2: 位於螢幕平面的距離。兩側的內容分別向前突出或向後退去。

column1: The frequency it pivots around -- what counts as 'low' and 'high' for the tilt.
column2: 傾斜圍繞的支點頻率，即劃分「低頻」與「高頻」的基準。

column1: The head drifting off the track: a band of noise rolls through the picture.
column2: 磁頭偏離磁軌：一條雜訊帶滾過畫面。

column1: The level below which the source is closed. Set it under the quietest thing you want to hear.
column2: 低於此位準時關閉訊號源。請設在想聽到的最輕聲音以下。

column1: The level it starts working at. Lower catches more of the performance.
column2: 開始處理的位準。設得越低，演出中受處理的部分越多。

column1: The plugin's first four automatable controls, in its own order. Everything else it has keeps whatever the plugin was left set to.
column2: 外掛程式按自身順序排列的前四個可自動化控制項。其餘設定均保持外掛程式上次的狀態。

column1: this output's renderer could not cut the mask
column2: 此輸出的算圖器無法裁切遮罩

column1: Tints the two directions apart, so light bending one way and the other are different colours instead of both being grey.
column2: 為兩個方向分別著色，使向兩側彎折的光呈現不同顏色，而非都是灰色。

column1: Turns the echo each pass, which winds the melt into a spiral.
column2: 每次回傳都旋轉殘影，使熔化效果捲成螺旋。

column1: Turns the strokes across the grain instead of along it, which combs the picture apart rather than smoothing it.
column2: 將筆觸轉為橫跨紋理，而非順著紋理，使畫面如被梳開般分離，而非平滑。

column1: Turns the whole arrangement, so the fold lines do not sit on the same part of the picture all night.
column2: 旋轉整個配置，使摺線不會整晚停留在畫面的同一位置。

column1: Two is a mirror, twelve is a snowflake, and they are completely different pictures.
column2: 兩個分區是鏡像，十二個分區是雪花，兩者會形成完全不同的畫面。

column1: unsaved changes will be lost: press new again
column2: 未儲存的變更將遺失：請再次按新建

column1: WEBMONITOR: STATUS | ON | OFF | CONTROL ON|OFF | SHARE ON|OFF | SOURCE PROGRAMME|<output> | QR [ON|OFF] | PORT <n> | PIN <pin>|OFF (sound is included)
column2: WEBMONITOR: STATUS | ON | OFF | CONTROL ON|OFF | SHARE ON|OFF | SOURCE PROGRAMME|<output> | QR [ON|OFF] | PORT <n> | PIN <pin>|OFF（包含聲音）

column1: Where highlights fold back through black. Low folds most of the picture, high folds only the brightest.
column2: 高光經過黑色後折返的位置。低值使大部分畫面折返，高值只使最亮部分折返。

column1: Where the band sits, 30Hz to 16kHz across the travel.
column2: 頻帶的位置，整個行程從 30Hz 到 16kHz。

column1: Where the fold sits: the middle at the left, toward the far edge to the right. Flips have no fold.
column2: 摺疊的位置：最左端在中央，向右則移向遠端邊緣。翻轉沒有摺線。

column1: Where the light stands, in degrees around the frame.
column2: 光源的位置，以繞畫面的角度表示。

column1: Where the source sits around the listener, all the way round. For headphones -- it is a timing and shading trick, not a pan.
column2: 訊號源在聽者周圍一整圈的位置。適用於耳機——利用時間差與音色塑形，並非聲像平移。

column1: Where the top ends, 200Hz to 20kHz. Pull it down to take the harshness off a bright source.
column2: 高頻截止位置，200Hz 到 20kHz。調低可減輕明亮音源的刺耳感。

column1: Which channel the curve acts on: all three, then red, green or blue on its own -- the way a colourist warms or cools one end of the picture.
column2: 曲線作用的通道：全部三個，或單獨的紅、綠、藍，類似調色師將畫面暗部或亮部調暖或調冷。

column1: Which way the knife edge lies. Only gradients ACROSS the edge show, so turning it swaps which features appear and which vanish.
column2: 刀口邊緣的方向。只有橫跨邊緣的梯度可見，因此旋轉會改變哪些特徵顯現或消失。

column1: Which way the streak runs: across at the left, upright in the middle, across again at the right.
column2: 條紋方向：左端為水平，中間為垂直，右端再次為水平。

column1: Widens the decision into a ramp, so edges keep their shape instead of jagging.
column2: 將判定邊界擴展為漸層，讓邊緣保持形狀而不產生鋸齒。

column1: Words to surface in the field, separated by | . One shows at a time, moving on the hold clock.
column2: 在場中浮現的詞語，用 | 分隔。每次顯示一個，按保持計時器切換。

column1: Zero is one noise value across all three channels, which reads as film. Higher gives each channel its own, which reads as video.
column2: 設為零時，三個通道使用相同的雜訊值，呈現膠片質感。調高後各通道有獨立雜訊，呈現視訊質感。

column1: zones cleared: Motion reads the whole picture
column2: 區域已清除：動作偵測讀取整個畫面
